body_en: [Machine] "I do not listen to the conversation musically, so I insist on following what I have heard."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَثَّامٌ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ «إِنِّي
body: لَأَسْمَعُ الْحَدِيثَ لَحْنًا فَأَلْحَنُ اتِّبَاعًا لِمَا سَمِعْتُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam > Sufyān > Ibrāhīm b. Maysarah
body_en: [Machine] Mujahid saw a peacock in his dream, as if he was praying in the Kaaba, and the Prophet ﷺ  was at the door of the Kaaba. He said to him, "O Abdullah, remove your mask and show your recitation." He said, "So it seemed that he understood this as a sign that he expanded in the conversation afterward."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ
body: رَأَى مُجَاهِدٌ طاوُوسًا فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّهُ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ يُصَلِّي مُتَقَنِّعًا وَالنَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَى بَابِ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اكْشِفْ قِنَاعَكَ وَأَظْهِرْ قِرَاءَتَكَ» قَالَ «فَكَأَنَّهُ عَبَّرَهُ عَلَى الْعِلْمِ فَانْبَسَطَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad > Ibn Yamān > Ibn Thawbān from his father > ʿAbdullāh b. Ḍamrah > Kaʿb
body_en: [Machine] "The world is cursed, cursed except for a person who learns good or teaches it."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ يَمَانٍ عَنِ ابْنِ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ
body: «الدُّنْيَا مَلْعُونَةٌ مَلْعُونٌ مَا فِيهَا إِلَّا مُتَعَلِّمَ خَيْرٍ أَوْ مُعَلِّمَهُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Kathīr > al-Awzāʿī > Baḥīr b. Saʿd > Khālid b. Maʿdān
body_en: People are ˹of two types˺: the scholar and the student, and between that is ignorance, with no goodness in it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ قَالَ
body: «النَّاسُ عَالِمٌ وَمُتَعَلِّمٌ وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ هَمَجٌ لَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam > ʿAbdullāh b. Rajāʾ > Hishām > al-Ḥasan
body_en: [Machine] They used to say, "The death of a scholar is a gap in Islam that cannot be filled. No matter the difference between night and day,".
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
body: كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ «مَوْتُ الْعَالِمِ ثُلْمَةٌ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ لَا يَسُدُّهَا شَيْءٌ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Yūsuf b. Mūsá > Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá > Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṣanʿānī > Mundhir > Ibn al-Nuʿmān > Wahbb. Munabbih
body_en: [Machine] "A gathering in which knowledge is disputed is more beloved to me than the amount of salah (prayer) I can perform. Perhaps someone will hear a word and benefit from it for a year or for the rest of their life."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُنْذِرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ قَالَ
body: «مَجْلِسٌ يُتَنَازَعُ فِيهِ الْعِلْمُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ قَدْرِهِ صَلَاةً لَعَلَّ أَحَدَهُمْ يَسْمَعُ الْكَلِمَةَ فَيَنْتَفِعُ بِهَا سَنَةً أَوْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Wakīʿ
body_en: [Machine] Sufyan said, "I do not know of a better action than seeking knowledge and preserving it for those whom Allah wishes good for."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنبَأَنَا وَكِيعٌ قَالَ
body: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ «مَا أَعْلَمُ عَمَلًا أَفْضَلَ مِنْ طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ وَحِفْظِهِ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بِهِ خَيْرًا»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Ṣāliḥ In
body_en: [Machine] And (he) said, Hasan ibn Salih said, "Indeed, people are in need of this knowledge in their religion, as they are in need of food and drink in their worldly life."
chain: null
body: وقَالَ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ «إِنَّ النَّاسَ لَيَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَى هَذَا الْعِلْمِ فِي دِينِهِمْ كَمَا يَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَى الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ فِي دُنْيَاهُمْ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Abū Nuʿaym And Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn > Misʿar > ʿAmr b. Murrah > Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd > Abū al-Dardāʾ Taʿallamūā Qabl
body_en: [Machine] Abu Darda said, "Learn before knowledge is taken away, because the taking away of knowledge is the taking away of scholars. And the scholar and the learner are equal in reward."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ قَالَ
body: قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ «تَعَلَّمُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ الْعِلْمُ فَإِنَّ قَبْضَ الْعِلْمِ قَبْضُ الْعُلَمَاءِ وَإِنَّ الْعَالِمَ وَالْمُتَعَلِّمَ فِي الْأَجْرِ سَوَاءٌ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah > Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth > Abū ʿAbdullāh al-Khurāsānī
body_en: [Machine] About Dahhak, he said, "But be scholars of the divine law because of what you have been teaching from the scripture." [Al-Imran 79]. He said, "It is obligatory upon everyone who reads the Qur'an to be knowledgeable."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ
body: عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ {وَلَكِنْ كُونُوا رَبَّانِيِّينَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ الْكِتَابَ} [آل عمران 79] قَالَ «حَقٌّ عَلَى كُلِّ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فَقِيهًا»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah > Ḥafṣ > Ashʿath b. Sawwār > al-Ḥasan Lawlā Yanhāhum al-Rabbāniyyūn And al-Aḥbār al-Māʾdh 63
body_en: [Machine] About Al-Hasan, if it weren't for the religious scholars and the scribes prohibiting them [the people], Al-Hasan said, "The wise scholars."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سَوَّارٍ
body: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ {لَوْلَا يَنْهَاهُمُ الرَّبَّانِيُّونَ وَالْأَحْبَارُ} [المائدة 63] قَالَ «الْحُكَمَاءُ الْعُلَمَاءُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah > Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī > ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib > Saʿīd b. Jubayr
body_en: [Machine] Sa'id ibn Jubayr said, "{Be devoutly obedient to Allah}" [Surah Al-Imran 79]. He further stated, "Scholars of jurisprudence."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ
body: عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ {كُونُوا رَبَّانِيِّينَ} [آل عمران 79] قَالَ «عُلَمَاءُ فُقَهَاءُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Saʿīd > Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah
body_en: [Machine] I heard Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah say, "Knowledge requires preservation, action, listening, attentiveness, and dissemination."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ
body: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عُيَيْنَةَ يَقُولُ «يُرَادُ لِلْعِلْمِ الْحِفْظُ وَالْعَمَلُ وَالِاسْتِمَاعُ وَالْإِنْصَاتُ وَالنَّشْرُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Wʾkhbrny Muḥammad Abū ʿAbdullāh > Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah
body_en: [Machine] "The most ignorant of people are those who abandon what they know, and the most knowledgeable of people are those who act upon what they know, and the best of people are those who are most humble before Allah, the Almighty."
chain: قَالَ وأخْبرني مُحَمَّدٌ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ
body: «أَجْهَلُ النَّاسِ مَنْ تَرَكَ مَا يَعْلَمُ وَأَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِمَا يَعْلَمُ وَأَفْضَلُ النَّاسِ أَخْشَعَهُمْ لِلَّهِ ﷻ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
title_en: Obsession with worldly desires leaves one constantly anxious and unfulfilled
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar al-Raqqī > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr > Zayd > Ibn Abū Unaysah > Sayyār > al-Ḥasan
body_en: Those who are obsessed are never satisfied: (1) those who are obsessed with ˹sacred and salvific˺ knowledge are never satisfied with it, and (2) those who are obsessed with worldly possessions are never satisfied with them. So, whoever makes the hereafter his concern, and devotes himself to it and focuses on it, Allah will take care of his worldly affairs, and He will put contentment in his heart. But whoever makes this world his concern, and devotes himself to it and focuses on it, Allah will expose his ruin, and He will make him ˹obsess over˺ his needs: such that he will not wake up except as a needy person, and he will not reach evening ˹while having pursued his needs˺ except as a needy person ˹anxious, feeling unfulfilled˺.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ زَيْدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ عَنْ سَيَّارٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
body: مَنْهُومَانِ لَا يَشْبَعَانِ مَنْهُومٌ فِي الْعِلْمِ لَا يَشْبَعُ مِنْهُ وَمَنْهُومٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَا يَشْبَعُ مِنْهَا فَمَنْ تَكُنِ الْآخِرَةُ هَمَّهُ وَبَثَّهُ وَسَدَمَهُ يَكْفِي اللَّهُ ضَيْعَتَهُ وَيَجْعَلُ غِنَاهُ فِي قَلْبِهِ وَمَنْ تَكُنِ الدُّنْيَا هَمَّهُ وَبَثَّهُ وَسَدَمَهُ يُفْشِي اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ضَيْعَتَهُ وَيَجْعَلُ فَقْرَهُ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُصْبِحُ إِلَّا فَقِيرًا وَلَا يُمْسِي إِلَّا فَقِيرًا

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn > Abū ʿUmays > ʿAwn > ʿAbdullāh
body_en: The one who possesses knowledge and the one who possesses worldly possessions are not equal, and both of them cannot be satisfied. As for the person of knowledge, their contentment with the Merciful (Allah) increases. But as for the person of the world, they indulge in transgression. Then Abdullah recited, "No! Indeed, man transgresses because he sees himself self-sufficient." (Quran, Surah Al-Alaq: 7) Someone else said, "Indeed, only the scholars fear Allah among His servants." (Quran, Surah Fatir: 28)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ عَنْ عَوْنٍ قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ
body: مَنْهُومَانِ لَا يَشْبَعَانِ صَاحِبُ الْعِلْمِ وَصَاحِبُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَسْتَوِيَانِ أَمَّا صَاحِبُ الْعِلْمِ فَيَزْدَادُ رِضًا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَأَمَّا صَاحِبُ الدُّنْيَا فَيَتَمَادَى فِي الطُّغْيَانِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ {كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغَى أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنَى} [العلق 7] قَالَ وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ {إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ} [فاطر 28]

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd > Ibrāhīm b. Mukhtār > ʿAnbasah b. al-Azhar > Simāk b. Ḥarb > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās Innamā Yakhshá Allāh from ʿIbādih al-ʿUlamāʾ Fāṭr 28
body_en: [Machine] "Who fears Allah is knowledgeable."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ الْأَزْهَرِ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: {إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ} [فاطر 28] قَالَ «مَنْ خَشِيَ اللَّهَ فَهُوَ عَالِمٌ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Abān > ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs > Layth > Ṭāwus > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] They are both never satisfied, the student of knowledge and the student of worldly affairs.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: مَنْهُومَانِ لَا يَشْبَعَانِ طَالِبُ عِلْمٍ وَطَالِبُ دُنْيَا

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Marwān b. Muḥammad > Yazīd b. Rabīʿah al-Ṣanʿānī > Rabīʿah b. Yazīd > Wāthilah b. al-Asqaʿ
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever seeks knowledge and attains it, will have a specific portion of reward. And if he does not attain it, he will have a portion of reward."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ وَاثِلَةَ بْنَ الْأَسْقَعِ يَقُولُ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ فَأَدْرَكَهُ كَانَ لَهُ كِفْلَانِ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ كَانَ لَهُ كِفْلٌ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Abū Shaybah > Marwān b. Muʿāwiyah > ʿAwf > ʿAbbās al-ʿAmmī > Balaghanī
body_en: [Machine] "The Prophet Dawud (pbuh) used to say in his supplication, 'Glory be to You, O Allah, You are my Lord, the Most Exalted above Your Throne, and You have made Your awe upon everyone in the heavens and the earth, and Your closest creation to You is the one who fears You the most, and what knowledge does one have who does not fear You? And what wisdom does one have who does not obey Your command?'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْعَمِّيِّ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي
body: أَنَّ دَاوُدَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ «سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي تَعَالَيْتَ فَوْقَ عَرْشِكَ وَجَعَلْتَ خَشْيَتَكَ عَلَى مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَأَقْرَبُ خَلْقِكَ مِنْكَ مَنْزِلَةً أَشَدُّهُمْ لَكَ خَشْيَةً وَمَا عِلْمُ مَنْ لَمْ يَخْشَكَ؟ وَمَا حِكْمَةُ مَنْ لَمْ يُطِعْ أَمْرَكَ؟»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: al-Muʿallá b. Asad > Sallām > Ibn Abū Muṭīʿ > Abū al-Hazhāz > al-Ḍaḥḥāk
body_en: [Machine] "Abdullah bin Mas'ud said, 'Tomorrow, be either a scholar or a student, for there is no good in anything else.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْهَزْهَازِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ قَالَ
body: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ «اغْدُ عَالِمًا أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمًا وَلَا خَيْرَ فِيمَا سِوَاهُمَا»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak > al-Walīd b. Muslim > al-Walīd b. Sulaymān > ʿAlī b. Yazīd > al-Qāsim Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman > Abū Umāmah
body_en: “There will be tribulation in which a man will be a believer in the morning and a disbeliever by evening, except the one to whom Allah grants knowledge.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3954)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ أَنبَأَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «سَتَكُونُ فِتَنٌ يُصْبِحُ الرَّجُلُ فِيهَا مُؤْمِنًا وَيُمْسِي كَافِرًا إِلَّا مَنْ أَحْيَاهُ اللَّهُ بِالْعِلْمِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Abū al-Mughīrah > al-Awzāʿī > Hārūn b. Rʾāb > ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
body_en: [Machine] "He used to say, 'Seek knowledge, whether you are a scholar or a student. Do not seek knowledge in between these two, for that is ignorance. Indeed, the angels spread their wings for the person seeking knowledge out of contentment with what they do.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ رئَابٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ
body: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «اغْدُ عَالِمًا أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمًا وَلَا تَغْدُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ جَاهِلٌ وَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَبْسُطُ أَجْنِحَتَهَا لِلرَّجُلِ غَدَا يَبْتَغِي الْعِلْمَ مِنَ الرِّضَا بِمَا يَصْنَعُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Abū al-Mughīrah > al-Awzāʿī > al-Ḥasan
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about two men from the Children of Israel. One of them was a scholar who would pray the obligatory prayers and then sit and teach people goodness. The other would fast during the day and stand in prayer during the night. Which of them is better? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The superiority of the scholar who prays the obligatory prayers and then sits teaching people goodness over the worshipper who fasts during the day and stands in prayer during the night is like my superiority over the most inferior among you."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
body: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ رَجُلَيْنِ كَانَا فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَحَدُهُمَا كَانَ عَالِمًا يُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيُعَلِّمُ النَّاسَ الْخَيْرَ وَالْآخَرُ يَصُومُ النَّهَارَ وَيَقُومُ اللَّيْلَ أَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَضْلُ هَذَا الْعَالِمِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيُعَلِّمُ النَّاسَ الْخَيْرَ عَلَى الْعَابِدِ الَّذِي يَصُومُ النَّهَارَ وَيَقُومُ اللَّيْلَ كَفَضْلِي عَلَى أَدْنَاكُمْ رَجُلًا»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. al-Rabīʿ > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbaydullāh > al-Ḥasan b. Dhakwān > Ibn Sīrīn
body_en: [Machine] I entered the mosque and saw Al-Aswad bin Suray' narrating and Humaid bin Abdul Rahman mentioning knowledge in one corner of the mosque. So, I inclined towards which of them should I sit with. I felt sleepy, then someone approached me and said, "Towards which of them did you incline to sit? If you wish, I can show you the place where Gabriel  ﷺ  used to sit from Humaid bin Abdul Rahman."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ
body: دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَإِذَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ سُرَيْعٍ يَقُصُّ وَحُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَذْكُرُ الْعِلْمَ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَمَيَّلْتُ إِلَى أَيِّهِمَا أَجْلِسُ فَنَعَسْتُ فَأَتَانِي آتٍ فَقَالَ مَيَّلْتَ إِلَى أَيِّهِمَا تَجْلِسُ؟ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَرَيْتُكَ مَكَانَ جِبْرَائِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ مِنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Naṣr b. ʿAlī > ʿAbdullāh b. Dāwud > ʿĀṣim b. Rajāʾ b. Ḥaywah > Dāwud b. Jamīl > Kathīr b. Qays
body_en: I was sitting with Abu Darda' in the mosque of Damascus when a man came to him and said: 'O Abu Darda', I have come to you from Al-Madinah, the city of the Messenger of Allah, for a Hadith which I have heard that you narrate from the Prophet.' He said: 'Did you not come for trade?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'Did you not come for anything else?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah say: Whoever follows a path in the pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise. The angels lower their wings in approval of the seeker of knowledge, and everyone in the heavens and on earth prays for forgiveness for the seeker of knowledge, even the fish in the sea. The superiority of the scholar over the worshipper is like the superiority of the moon above all other heavenly bodies. The scholars are the heirs of the Prophets, for the Prophets did not leave behind a Dinar or Dirham, rather they left behind knowledge, so whoever takes it has taken a great share.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 223)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ رَجَاءِ بْنِ حَيْوَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ
body: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي مَسْجِدِ دِمَشْقَ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ مَدِينَةِ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ لِحَدِيثٍ بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ تُحَدِّثُهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فَمَا جَاءَ بِكَ تِجَارَةٌ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ وَلَا جَاءَ بِكَ غَيْرُهُ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ بِهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا مِنْ طُرُقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَتَضَعُ أَجْنِحَتَهَا رِضًا لِطَالِبِ الْعِلْمِ وَإِنَّ طَالِبَ الْعِلْمِ لَيَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ حَتَّى الْحِيتَانُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَإِنَّ فَضْلَ الْعَالِمِ عَلَى الْعَابِدِ كَفَضْلِ الْقَمَرِ عَلَى سَائِرِ النُّجُومِ إِنَّ الْعُلَمَاءَ هُمْ وَرَثَةُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ إِنَّ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ لَمْ يُوَرِّثُوا دِينَارًا وَلَا دِرْهَمًا وَإِنَّمَا وَرَّثُوا الْعِلْمَ فَمَنْ أَخَذَ بِهِ أَخَذَ بِحَظِّهِ أَوْ بِحَظٍّ وَافِرٍ »

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah > Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī > al-Aʿmash > Shimr b. ʿAṭiyyah > Saʿīd b. Jubayr > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] "The teacher of goodness is forgiven by everything, even the whale in the sea."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ شِمْرِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: «مُعَلِّمُ الْخَيْرِ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى الْحُوتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus > Zāʾidah > al-Aʿmash > Abū Ṣāliḥ > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: If anyone pursues a path in search of knowledge, Allah will thereby make easy for him a path to paradise; and he who is made slow by his actions will not be speeded by his genealogy. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3643)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَسْلُكُ طَرِيقًا يَطْلُبُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا إِلَّا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ أَبْطَأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Abān > Yaʿqūb > al-Qqummī > Hārūn b. ʿAntarah from his father > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] A man who traverses a road seeking knowledge, Allah will make it easy for him to reach Paradise through it. And whoever hinders his efforts, his lineage will not make him hasten.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ هُوَ الْقُّمِّيُّ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ عَنْتَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: «مَا سَلَكَ رَجُلٌ طَرِيقًا يَبْتَغِي فِيهِ الْعِلْمَ إِلَّا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ يُبْطِئْ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Kathīr > Ibn Shawdhab > Maṭar
body_en: [Machine] About rain, "And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?" [Al-Qamar 17] He said, "Is there anyone who seeks goodness that I may guide him towards it?"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شَوْذَبٍ عَنْ مَطَرٍ
body: {وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ} [القمر 17] قَالَ «هَلْ مِنْ طَالِبِ خَيْرٍ فَيُعَانَ عَلَيْهِ؟»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Ḍmrh
body_en: [Machine] "Student of knowledge"
chain: وأخْبرنا مرْوانُ عنْ ضمْرةَ قَالَ
body: «طالبُ عِلمٍ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Abān > Yaʿqūb > al-Qummī > ʿĀmir b. Ibrāhīm
body_en: [Machine] Abu Darda used to say "Welcome to the students of knowledge" when he saw them, and he used to say, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  advised and encouraged you."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ هُوَ الْقُمِّيُّ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ
body: كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ إِذَا رَأَى طَلَبَةَ الْعِلْمِ قَالَ مَرْحَبًا بِطَلَبَةِ الْعِلْمِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَوْصَى بِكُمْ

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ziyād b. Anʿum > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Rāfiʿ > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
body_en: [Machine] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by two gatherings in his mosque and said, 'Both of them are good, and one of them is better than the other. As for these people, they supplicate to Allah and seek His blessings. If He wills, He grants their requests, and if He wills, He withholds them. As for these people, they learn jurisprudence and knowledge, and they teach the ignorant. They are the best, as I have been sent as a teacher.' Then he sat among them."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَنْعُمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِمَجْلِسَيْنِ فِي مَسْجِدِهِ فَقَالَ «كِلَاهُمَا عَلَى خَيْرٍ وَأَحَدُهُمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ أَمَّا هَؤُلَاءِ فَيَدْعُونَ اللَّهَ وَيَرْغَبُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَإِنْ شَاءَ أَعْطَاهُمْ وَإِنْ شَاءَ مَنَعَهُمْ وَأَمَّا هَؤُلَاءِ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ الْفِقْهَ والعلمَ وَيُعَلِّمُونَ الْجَاهِلَ فَهُمْ أَفْضَلُ وَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ مُعَلِّمًا» قَالَ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فِيهِمْ

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd > al-Masʿūdī > ʿAwn b. ʿAbdullāh > Muṭarrif b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Shikhhīr
body_en: [Machine] He said to his son, "O my son, indeed knowledge is better than action."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ
body: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِابْنِهِ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّ «الْعِلْمَ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd > Ḥaywah > Shuraḥbīl b. Sharīk > Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Ḥubulī
body_en: [Machine] He heard Aba Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli say, "There is no better gift than a word of wisdom that you give to your brother."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ شَرِيكٍ
body: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيَّ يَقُولُ «لَيْسَ هَدِيَّةٌ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ حِكْمَةٍ تُهْدِيهَا لِأَخِيكَ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān > Yaḥyá b. Yamān > Muḥammad b. ʿAjlān > al-Zuhrī
body_en: [Machine] "The superiority of a knowledgeable person over a diligent person is one hundred degrees, which is equivalent to five hundred years of the presence of an illuminated Persian stallion."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ
body: «فَضْلُ الْعَالِمِ عَلَى الْمُجْتَهِدِ مِائَةُ دَرَجَةٍ مَا بَيْنَ الدَّرَجَتَيْنِ خَمْسُ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ حُضْرُ الْفَرَسِ الْمُضَمَّرِ السَّرِيعِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd > Ḥaywah > al-Sakan b. Abū Karīmah > ʿIkrimah a freed slave of Ibn ʿAbbās > Ibn ʿAbbās Yarfaʿ Allāh al--Adhīn Āmanūā Minkum And al--Adhīn Ūtūā al-ʿIlm Darajāt al-Mjādlh 11
body_en: [Machine] Allah raises those who have been given knowledge above those who believe by degrees.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي السَّكَنُ بْنُ أَبِي كَرِيمَةَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: {يَرْفَعُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ} [المجادلة 11] قَالَ يَرْفَعُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِدَرَجَاتٍ

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Bishr b. Thābit al-Bazzār > Naṣr b. al-Qāsim > Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl > ʿAmr b. Kathīr > al-Ḥasan
body_en: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “When death comes while ones in seeking knowledge to revive Islam there is but one rank between him and the Prophets in Jannah.”
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْبَزَّارُ حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ جَاءَهُ الْمَوْتُ وَهُوَ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِيُحْيِيَ بِهِ الْإِسْلَامَ فَبَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ النَّبِيِّينَ دَرَجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd > Mihrān > Abū Sinān > Abū Isḥāq > ʿAmr b. Maymūn
body_en: [Machine] "Umar's knowledge decreased by two thirds," I said to Ibrahim. He replied, "Umar's knowledge decreased by nine tenths."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مِهْرَانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ قَالَ
body: «ذَهَبَ عُمَرُ بِثُلُثَيِ الْعِلْمِ» قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَ «ذَهَبَ عُمَرُ بِتِسْعَةِ أَعْشَارِ الْعِلْمِ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: Bishr b. Thābit > Shuʿbah > Yazīd Abū Khālid > Hārūn from his father > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] "Whenever a group of people gather in one of the houses of Allah to study and discuss the Book of Allah among themselves, the angels lower their wings in humility and tranquility. They encompass them with their wings until they are immersed in their discussions. If someone traverses a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes their path to Paradise easy. And those whose actions are slow in progressing, their lineage will not hasten them."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ أَنبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: «مَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتَذَاكَرُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا أَظَلَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا حَتَّى يَخُوضُوا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ وَمَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَبْتَغِي بِهِ الْعِلْمَ سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ طَرِيقَهُ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ أَبْطَأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ»

h2_title_en: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim > Ḥammād > Ibn Salamah > ʿĀṣim > Zir > Ghadawt > Ṣafwān b. ʿAssāl al-Murādī > Urīd > Asʾalah > al-Masḥ > al-Khuffayn > Mā Jāʾ Bik Qult Ābtighāʾ al-ʿIlm > Alā Ubashhiruk Qult Balá
body_en: [Machine] "What brought you here?" I said, "The pursuit of knowledge." He said, "Should I not give you glad tidings?" I said, "Yes." So he raised the conversation to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and said, "Indeed, the angels lower their wings for the seeker of knowledge, pleased with what he seeks."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ زِرٍّ قَالَ غَدَوْتُ عَلَى صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ الْمُرَادِيِّ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ عَنِ الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ فَقَالَ
body: مَا جَاءَ بِكَ؟ قُلْتُ ابْتِغَاءُ الْعِلْمِ قَالَ أَلَا أُبَشِّرُكَ؟ قُلْتُ بَلَى فَقَالَ رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَالَ «إِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَتَضَعُ أَجْنِحَتَهَا لِطَالِبِ الْعِلْمِ رِضًا بِمَا يَطْلُبُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Whoever seeks knowledge without intention, knowledge returns to intention
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ فَرَدَّهُ الْعِلْمُ إِلَى النِّيَّةِ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān > Yaḥyá b. Yamān > Sufyān Mundh Arbaʿīn Sanah
body_en: [Machine] "The request for conversation today was not better than it. They (the people) said to Sufyan, 'Indeed, they seek it without intent?' He said, 'Their seeking it is with intent.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ مُنْذُ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ
body: «مَا كَانَ طَلَبُ الْحَدِيثِ أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ الْيَوْمَ» قَالُوا لِسُفْيَانَ إِنَّهُمْ يَطْلُبُونَهُ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ؟ قَالَ «طَلَبُهُمْ إِيَّاهُ نِيَّةٌ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Whoever seeks knowledge without intention, knowledge returns to intention
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ فَرَدَّهُ الْعِلْمُ إِلَى النِّيَّةِ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd > ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ajlaḥ from my father > Mujāhid
body_en: [Machine] "We have sought this knowledge, and we do not have a great intention in it. Then Allah provided us with the intention."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْأَجْلَحِ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ
body: «طَلَبْنَا هَذَا الْعِلْمَ وَمَا لَنَا فِيهِ كَبِيرُ نِيَّةٍ ثُمَّ رَزَقَ اللَّهُ بَعْدُ فِيهِ النِّيَّةَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Whoever seeks knowledge without intention, knowledge returns to intention
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ فَرَدَّهُ الْعِلْمُ إِلَى النِّيَّةِ
chain_en: Bishr b. Thābit al-Bazzār > Ḥassān b. Muslim > Yūnus b. ʿUbayd > al-Ḥasan
body_en: [Machine] "People have sought knowledge for the sake of Allah and not for what they can gain from it. He (the Prophet) said, 'Knowledge has remained with them until they sought it for the sake of Allah and not for what they can gain from it.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْبَزَّارُ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
body: «لَقَدْ طَلَبَ أَقْوَامٌ الْعِلْمَ مَا أَرَادُوا بِهِ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى وَلَا مَا عِنْدَهُ» قَالَ «فَمَا زَالَ بِهِمُ الْعِلْمُ حَتَّى أَرَادُوا بِهِ اللَّهَ وَمَا عِنْدَهُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb > Ḥammād b. Zayd > Ayyūb > Abū Qilābah
body_en: [Machine] Abu Muslim al-Khawlanī said, "The scholars are of three types: a man who lived in his knowledge and the people lived with him in it, a man who lived in his knowledge and no one lived with him in it, and a man who people lived in his knowledge and he was confused by it."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ قَالَ قَالَ
body: أَبُو مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيُّ «الْعُلَمَاءُ ثَلَاثَةٌ فَرَجُلٌ عَاشَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَعَاشَ مَعَهُ النَّاسُ فِيهِ وَرَجُلٌ عَاشَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَلَمْ يَعِشْ مَعَهُ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ وَرَجُلٌ عَاشَ النَّاسُ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَكَانَ وَبَالًا عَلَيْهِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá > ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad > ʿAṭāʾ > Mūsá ʿAlayh al-Salām Yā Rab Ay ʿIbādik Aḥkam > al--Adhī Yaḥkum Lilnnās Kamā Yaḥkum Linafsih > Yā Rab Ay ʿIbādik Aghná > Arḍāhum Bimā Qasamt Lah > Yā Rab Ay ʿIbādik Akhshá Lak
body_en: [Machine] Prophet Musa ﷺ  asked his Lord, "O Lord, who among your servants is the most fair in judgment?" He replied, "The one who judges people as he judges himself." Musa ﷺ  asked, "O Lord, who among your servants is the richest?" He replied, "Those whom I have satisfied with what I have given them." Musa ﷺ  asked, "O Lord, who among your servants is the most fearful of you?" He replied, "Those who know me the best."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ قَالَ
body: مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَا رَبِّ أَيُّ عِبَادِكَ أَحْكَمُ؟ قَالَ الَّذِي يَحْكُمُ لِلنَّاسِ كَمَا يَحْكُمُ لِنَفْسِهِ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ أَيُّ عِبَادِكَ أَغْنَى؟ قَالَ أَرْضَاهُمْ بِمَا قَسَمْتُ لَهُ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ أَيُّ عِبَادِكَ أَخْشَى لَكَ؟ قَالَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِي

chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Sufyān
body_en: [Machine] It is said that there are three types of scholars: a scholar who fears Allah but is not well-versed in His commands, a scholar who fears Allah and is knowledgeable about His commands, and that is the perfect scholar, and a scholar who is knowledgeable about His commands but does not fear Allah, and that is the corrupt scholar.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ قَالَ كَانَ
body: يُقَالُ الْعُلَمَاءُ ثَلَاثَةٌ عَالِمٌ بِاللَّهِ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِعَالِمٍ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ وَعَالِمٌ بِاللَّهِ عَالِمٌ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ فَذَاكَ الْعَالِمُ الْكَامِلُ وَعَالِمٌ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ لَيْسَ بِعَالِمٍ بِاللَّهِ لَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ فَذَلِكَ الْعَالِمُ الْفَاجِرُ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Makkī b. Ibrāhīm > Hishām > al-Ḥasan
body_en: [Machine] Knowledge is of two types: knowledge in the heart, and knowledge on the tongue. Knowledge in the heart is beneficial knowledge, and knowledge on the tongue is the evidence of Allah over the son of Adam.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
body: الْعِلْمُ عِلْمَانِ فَعِلْمٌ فِي الْقَلْبِ فَذَلِكَ الْعِلْمُ النَّافِعُ وَعِلْمٌ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ فَذَلِكَ حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ

chain_en: ʿĀṣim b. Yūsuf > Fuḍayl b. ʿIyāḍ > Hishām > al-Ḥasan
body_en: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters. (Using translation from Muslim 1929i)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عِيَاضٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ

chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn > Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh > Yazīd b. Abū Ziyād > Ibrāhīm > ʿAlqamah > ʿAbdullāh
body_en: [Machine] "Learn, learn, and when you have learned, act."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
body: «تَعَلَّمُوا تَعَلَّمُوا فَإِذَا عَلِمْتُمْ فَاعْمَلُوا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Abū ʿUbayd al-Qāsim b. Sallām > Abū Ismāʿīl > Ibrāhīm b. Sulaymān al-Muʾaddib > ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal > Man > Abū Wāʾil > ʿAbdullāh
body_en: [Machine] Whoever seeks knowledge for four purposes: to enter into Hell, to boast to scholars, to mock fools, to turn people's faces towards him, or to manipulate rulers.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْمَاعِيلَ هُوَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْمُؤَدِّبُ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ مَنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
body: مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ لِأَرْبَعٍ دَخَلَ النَّارَ أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةِ لِيُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِيُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ أَوْ لِيَصْرِفَ بِهِ وُجُوهَ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهِ أَوْ لِيَأْخُذَ بِهِ مِنَ الْأُمَرَاءِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Hishām Ṣāḥib al-Dastawāʾī
body_en: [Machine] "From the words of Jesus, peace be upon him, you work for the world and you are provided for in it without any effort, and you do not work for the hereafter and you are not provided for in it except by your deeds! Woe to you, evil scholars who take rewards and waste deeds! The Lord of deeds is about to demand his own work, and you are about to leave this vast world for the darkness of the grave and its narrowness. Allah forbids you from sins as He commanded you to pray and fast. How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they become angry with their sustenance and belittle their position, knowing that it is from the knowledge and power of Allah? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they accuse Allah of what He has decreed for them and is not pleased with what afflictions have befallen them? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they prioritize their worldly life over their hereafter, when they are in this world with a greater desire? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if their destination is towards their hereafter, while they are inclined towards their worldly life and what harms them is more delicious or beloved to them than what benefits them? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they seek knowledge only to inform others of it, and not to act upon it?"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ فِي كِتَابٍ بَلَغَنِي
body: أَنَّهُ مِنْ كَلَامِ عِيسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ تَعْمَلُونَ لِلدُّنْيَا وَأَنْتُمْ تُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ عَمَلٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ لِلْآخِرَةِ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا إِلَّا بِالْعَمَلِ ويلَّكمْ عُلَمَاءَ السَّوْءِ الْأَجْرَ تَأْخُذُونَ وَالْعَمَلَ تُضَيِّعُونَ يُوشِكُ رَبُّ الْعَمَلِ أَنْ يَطْلُبَ عَمَلَهُ وَتُوشِكُونَ أَنْ تَخْرُجُوا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا الْعَرِيضَةِ إِلَى ظُلْمَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَضِيقِهِ اللَّهُ ينهاكمْ عَنِ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا أَمَرَكُمْ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالصِّيَامِ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ سَخِطَ رِزْقَهُ وَاحْتَقَرَ مَنْزِلَتَهُ وَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنِ اتَّهَمَ اللَّهَ فِيمَا قَضَى لَهُ فَلَيْسَ يَرْضَى شَيْئًا أَصَابَهُ؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ دُنْيَاهُ آثَرُ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ آخِرَتِهِ وَهُوَ فِي الدُّنْيَا أَفْضَلُ رَغْبَةً؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ مَصِيرُهُ إِلَى آخِرَتِهِ وَهُوَ مُقْبِلٌ عَلَى دُنْيَاهُ وَمَا يَضُرُّهُ أَشْهَى إِلَيْهِ أَوْ قَالَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا يَنْفَعُهُ؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْكَلَامَ لِيُخْبِرَ بِهِ وَلَا يَطْلُبُهُ لِيَعْمَلَ بِهِ؟

h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd > Ḥarīz > Ḥabīb b. ʿUbayd
body_en: [Machine] It is said, "Learn knowledge and benefit from it, and do not learn it for the purpose of showing off, for it is very likely that if your life span is prolonged, the person with knowledge will show off with his knowledge just as the person with a fine garment shows off with his garment."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيزٌ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ كَانَ
body: يُقَالُ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ وَانْتَفِعُوا بِهِ وَلَا تَعَلَّمُوهُ لِتَتَجَمَّلُوا بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُوشِكُ إِنْ طَالَ بِكُمْ عُمُرٌ أَنْ يَتَجَمَّلَ ذُو الْعِلْمِ بِعِلْمِهِ كَمَا يَتَجَمَّلُ ذُو الْبِزَّةِ بِبِزَّتِهِ»

h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād > Baqiyyah > al-Aḥwaṣ b. Ḥakīm from his father
body_en: [Machine] A man asked the Prophet ﷺ  about evil, and he replied "Do not ask me about evil, but ask me about goodness" and he repeated this three times. Then he said, "Indeed, the worst of evil is the evil of scholars, and the best of goodness is the goodness of scholars."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنِ الْأَحْوَصِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ الشَّرِّ فَقَالَ «لَا تَسْأَلُونِي عَنِ الشَّرِّ وَاسْأَلُونِي عَنِ الْخَيْرِ يَقُولُهَا ثَلَاثًا» ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَلَا إِنَّ شَرَّ الشَّرِّ شِرَارُ الْعُلَمَاءِ وَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الْخَيْرِ خِيَارُ الْعُلَمَاءِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Ḥumayd b. al-Aswad > ʿĪsá > al-Shaʿbī
body_en: [Machine] I heard Sha'abi saying that the seeking of this knowledge was only for those who possess two qualities: intellect and devotion. If someone is devoted but lacks intellect, he would say, "This is a matter that only the wise pursue," and he would not seek it. And if someone is intelligent but lacks devotion, he would say, "This is a matter that only the devout pursue," and he would not seek it. Then Sha'abi said, "I was afraid that today someone who possesses neither of these qualities would seek it."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عِيسَى قَالَ
body: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَطْلُبُ هَذَا الْعِلْمَ مَنِ اجْتَمَعَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَتَانِ الْعَقْلُ وَالنُّسُكُ فَإِنْ كَانَ نَاسِكًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ عَاقِلًا قَالَ هَذَا أَمْرٌ لَا يَنَالُهُ إِلَّا الْعُقَلَاءُ فَلَمْ يَطْلُبْهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَاقِلًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ نَاسِكًا قَالَ هَذَا أَمْرٌ لَا يَنَالُهُ إِلَّا النُّسَّاكُ فَلَمْ يَطْلُبْهُ فَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ وَلَقَدْ رَهِبْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ يَطْلُبُهُ الْيَوْمَ مَنْ لَيْسَتْ فِيهِ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُمَا لَا عَقْلٌ وَلَا نُسُكٌ

body_en: [Machine] The sentence translates to: "The man did not seek knowledge until he had worshipped for forty years before that."

body: «كَانَ الرَّجُلُ لَا يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ حَتَّى يَتَعَبَّدَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً»

h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Sufyān > Burd b. Sinān Abū al-ʿAlāʾ > Makḥūl
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever seeks knowledge in order to argue with the foolish, or to show off before the scholars, or to attract people's attention, will be in Hell." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 253)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ بُرْدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ
body: «مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ لِيُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ وَلِيُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِيَصْرِفَ بِهِ وُجُوهَ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ»

chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Bisṭām > Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah > al-Nuʿmān > Makḥūl
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever seeks knowledge in order to argue with the foolish, or to show off before the scholars, or to attract people's attention, Allah will admit him to Hell.' (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 260)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنِي النُّعْمَانُ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ لِيُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِيُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ أَوْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُقْبِلَ بِوُجُوهِ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهِ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ جَهَنَّمَ»

body_en: [Machine] "The speech of a person is guarded according to his intention."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ > Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah > Ibn Abū Ḥusayn > Shahr b. Ḥawshab > Balaghanī
body_en: [Machine] Luqman the wise used to say to his son, "Oh my son, do not seek knowledge in order to show off to the scholars, to challenge the foolish, or to impress people in gatherings. And do not abandon knowledge out of arrogance and desire for ignorance. Oh my son, choose your companions wisely. If you see a group of people remembering God, then sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will teach you. Perhaps Allah will bless you with His mercy through them and grant you their righteousness. But if you see a group of people who do not remember God, then do not sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will not benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will increase you in ignorance. Perhaps Allah will expose them to punishment, and you will befall the same fate."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي
body: أَنَّ لُقْمَانَ الْحَكِيمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ لِابْنِهِ «يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَعَلَّمِ الْعِلْمَ لِتُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِتُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ أَوْ تُرَائِيَ بِهِ فِي الْمَجَالِسِ وَلَا تَتْرُكِ الْعِلْمَ زُهْدًا فِيهِ وَرَغْبَةً فِي الْجَهَالَةِ يَا بُنَيَّ اخْتَرِ الْمَجَالِسَ عَلَى عَيْنِكَ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَاجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَكُنْ عَالِمًا يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُنْ جَاهِلًا يُعَلِّمُوكَ وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ فَيُصِيبَكَ بِهَا مَعَهُمْ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَلَا تَجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَكُنْ عَالِمًا لَا يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُنْ جَاهِلًا زَادُوكَ غَيًّا وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِعَذَابٍ فَيُصِيبَكَ مَعَهُمْ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: Yūsuf b. Mūsá > Isḥāq b. Sulaymān > Ḥarīz > Salmān b. Sumayr > Kathīr b. Murrah
body_en: [Machine] "Do not speak falsehood in front of the wise, as they will despise you. Do not speak wisdom to the foolish, as they will deny you. Do not prevent knowledge from those who deserve it, for you would commit a sin. And do not place it in the hands of those who are not qualified, as you would be disregarded. Know that you have a responsibility towards your knowledge, just as you have a responsibility towards your wealth."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيزٌ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ سُمَيْرٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ قَالَ
body: «لَا تُحَدِّثِ الْبَاطِلَ الْحُكَمَاءَ فَيَمْقُتُوكَ وَلَا تُحَدِّثِ الْحِكْمَةَ لِلسُّفَهَاءِ فَيُكَذِّبُوكَ وَلَا تَمْنَعِ الْعِلْمَ أَهْلَهُ فَتَأْثَمَ وَلَا تَضَعْهُ فِي غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِ فَتُجَهَّلَ إِنَّ عَلَيْكَ فِي عِلْمِكَ حَقًّا كَمَا أَنَّ عَلَيْكَ فِي مَالِكَ حَقًّا»

chain_en: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad > Sufyān > Dāwud b. Shābūr > Shahr b. Ḥawshab
body_en: [Machine] "Luqman said to his son: 'O my son, do not seek knowledge to boast to the scholars, argue with the ignorant, show off in gatherings, or abandon knowledge in arrogance and desire for ignorance. And when you see people who do not remember Allah, sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will teach you. Perhaps Allah will guide them through His mercy and you will be blessed with it too. And when you see people who do not remember Allah, do not sit with them. If you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will not benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will increase you in deviation and heedlessness. Perhaps Allah will reveal His displeasure upon them and you will be affected with them.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ شَابُورَ سَمِعَ شَهْرَ بْنَ حَوْشَبٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ
body: لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ «يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَعَلَّمِ الْعِلْمَ لِتُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ وتُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ وَتُرَائِيَ بِهِ فِي الْمَجَالِسِ وَلَا تَتْرُكِ الْعِلْمَ زَهَادَةً فِيهِ وَرَغْبَةً فِي الْجَهَالَةِ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا لا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَاجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ إِنْ تَكُ عَالِمًا يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُ جَاهِلًا عَلَّمُوكَ وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ فَيُصِيبَكَ بِهَا مَعَهُمْ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَلَا تَجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ إِنْ تَكُ عَالِمًا لَمْ يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُ جَاهِلًا زَادُوكَ غَيًّا أَوْ عِيًّا وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَخَطٍ فَيُصِيبَكَ بِهِ مَعَهُمْ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah
h2_title: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Bishr from my father > Sufyān > Thūwayr > Yaḥyá b. Jaʿdah > ʿAlī
body_en: [Machine] "O holders of knowledge, act upon it, for true scholars are those who act upon what they know and align their actions with their knowledge. There will be people who possess knowledge but their actions do not reach the level of their knowledge. Their behavior contradicts their knowledge and their true intentions differ from what they display. They sit in gatherings to show off, competing with one another, to the extent that a person might get angry if their companion sits with someone else. Those individuals' deeds do not ascend to the heavens, rather they are presented to Allah the Almighty."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَعْدَةَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ
body: «يَا حَمَلَةَ الْعِلْمِ اعْمَلُوا بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا الْعَالِمُ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِمَا عَلِمَ وَوَافَقَ عِلْمُهُ عَمَلَهُ وَسَيَكُونُ أَقْوَامٌ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعِلْمَ لَا يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ يُخَالِفُ عَمَلُهُمْ عِلْمَهُمْ وَتُخَالِفُ سَرِيرَتُهُمْ عَلَانِيَتَهُمْ يَجْلِسُونَ حِلَقًا فَيُبَاهِيَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا حَتَّى إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَغْضَبُ عَلَى جَلِيسِهِ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَيَدَعَهُ أُولَئِكَ لَا تَصْعَدُ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فِي مَجَالِسِهِمْ تِلْكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى»

body_en: [Machine] Two men from the followers of whims entered upon Ibn Seerin and said, "O Abu Bakr, shall we narrate a hadith to you?" He replied, "No." They said, "Then shall we recite a verse from the Book of Allah to you?" He replied, "No, so that you may not distort it and have that remain in my heart." Some people among them said, "O Abu Bakr, why was it upon you not to let them recite a verse from the Book of Allah, the Exalted?" He said, "I feared that they would recite a verse upon me and then distort it, and that would remain in my heart."

body_en: [Machine] "There is no opinion for anyone in the Book of Allah. Rather, the only opinion is that of the Imams regarding matters for which there is no book revealed, nor has a sunnah been passed down from the Messenger of Allah. And there is no opinion for anyone in a sunnah established by the Messenger of Allah."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَافَى عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ «كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
body: أَنَّهُ لَا رَأْيَ لِأَحَدٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا رَأْيُ الْأَئِمَّةِ فِيمَا لَمْ يَنْزِلْ فِيهِ كِتَابٌ وَلَمْ تَمْضِ بِهِ سُنَّةٌ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلَا رَأْيَ لِأَحَدٍ فِي سُنَّةٍ سَنَّهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet  ﷺ  and the Words of Others When He  ﷺ  Speaks.
h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chain_en: Mūsá b. Khālid > Muʿtamir b. Sulaymān > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar > ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ؒ Khaṭab
body_en: [Machine] "O people, Allah has not sent a prophet after your prophet, nor has He revealed any book after this book that He has sent down upon him. What Allah has made lawful on the tongue of His prophet is lawful until the Day of Resurrection, and what He has made forbidden on the tongue of His prophet is forbidden until the Day of Resurrection. Know that I am not a judge, but rather a conveyor. I am not an innovator, but a follower. I am not better than you except that I bear a heavier burden. Indeed, no one from the creation of Allah should be obeyed in disobeying Allah. Have you heard?"
chain: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ
body: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَبْعَثْ بَعْدَ نَبِيِّكُمْ نَبِيًّا وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ بَعْدَ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ كِتَابًا فَمَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ فَهُوَ حَلَالٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا وَإِنِّي لَسْتُ بِقاضٍّ وَلَكِنِّي مُنَفِّذٌ وَلَسْتُ بِمُبْتَدِعٍ وَلَكِنِّي مُتَّبِعٌ وَلَسْتُ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْكُمْ غَيْرَ أَنِّي أَثْقَلُكُمْ حِمْلًا أَلَا وَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ أَنْ يُطَاعَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ أَلَا هَلْ أَسْمَعْتُ؟؟»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet  ﷺ  and the Words of Others When He  ﷺ  Speaks.
h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Saʿīd > Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah > Hishām b. Ḥujayr
body_en: [Machine] There was a peacock praying two units after Asr prayer, so Ibn Abbas said to him, "Leave them." He said, "It was only forbidden to perform them on a ladder." Ibn Abbas said, "Indeed, prayer after Asr has been forbidden, so I do not know whether you will be punished for it or rewarded, for Allah says, 'It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.'" (Quran 33:36) Sufyan said, "He considers it to be on a ladder, meaning he prays from after Asr until the night."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حُجَيْرٍ قَالَ
body: كَانَ طاووسٌ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «اتْرُكْهُمَا» قَالَ «إِنَّمَا نُهِيَ عَنْهَا أَنْ تُتَّخَذُ سُلَّمًا» قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ نُهِيَ عَنْ صَلَاةٍ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَلَا أَدْرِي أَتُعَذَّبُ عَلَيْهَا أَمْ تُؤْجَرُ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ {وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقْدَ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُبِينًا} [الأحزاب 36] قَالَ سُفْيَانُ تُتَّخَذَ سُلَّمًا يَقُولُ يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet  ﷺ  and the Words of Others When He  ﷺ  Speaks.
h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ > Ibn Numayr > Mujālid > ʿĀmir > Jābir
body_en: [Machine] "Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with a copy of the Torah, and he said: 'O Messenger of Allah, this is a copy of the Torah.' Then he remained silent and started reading. The face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  changed. Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'May you be sacrificed for this moment! Why do you not see the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?' So Umar looked at the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said: 'I seek refuge in Allah from the anger of Allah and the anger of His Messenger. We are pleased with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and Muhammad as our Prophet.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'We are pleased with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and Muhammad as our Prophet.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'By the One in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, if Moses were to appear to you and you were to follow him and abandon me, you would be led astray from the right path. And if he were alive during my prophethood, he would have followed me.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
body: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِنُسْخَةٍ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذِهِ نُسْخَةٌ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ فَسَكَتَ فَجَعَلَ يَقْرَأُ وَوَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ يَتَغَيَّرُ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ثَكِلَتْكَ الثَّوَاكِلُ مَا تَرَى بِوَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ فَنَظَرَ عُمَرُ إِلَى وَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ غَضَبِ اللَّهِ وَغَضَبِ رَسُولِهِ رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْ بَدَا لَكُمْ مُوسَى فَاتَّبَعْتُمُوهُ وَتَرَكْتُمُونِي لَضَلَلْتُمْ عَنْ سَوَاءِ السَّبِيلِ وَلَوْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَأَدْرَكَ نُبُوَّتِي لَاتَّبَعَنِي»

h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chain_en: Qabīṣah > Sufyān > Abū Rabāḥ Shaykh from Āl ʿUmar > Raʾá Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib a man Yuṣallī Baʿd al-ʿAṣr al-Rakʿatayn Yukabbir > Lah Yā Abū Muḥammad Ayuʿadhhibunī Allāh > al-Ṣalāh
body_en: [Machine] From Abu Rabah, a sheikh from the family of Umar, he said: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib saw a man praying two rak'ahs after Asr and making takbir (saying Allah is the greatest). Sa'id said to him, "O Abu Muhammad, does Allah punish me for praying?" He said, "No, but Allah punishes you for going against the sunnah."
chain: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ
body: عَنْ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ شَيْخٌ مِنْ آلِ عُمَرَ قَالَ رَأَى سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ يُكَبِّرُ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَيُعَذِّبُنِي اللَّهُ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ؟ قَالَ «لَا وَلَكِنْ يُعَذِّبُكَ اللَّهُ بِخِلَافِ السُّنَّةِ»

h2_title: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ > al-Layth > Ibn ʿAjlān > al-ʿAjlān > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who said, "While a man was admiring his two garments, Allah caused the earth to swallow him up, and he will continue to be swallowed by it until the Day of Resurrection." A young boy, whose name he mentioned and who was with him, said, "O Abu Hurayrah, was this the way the boy who was swallowed up used to walk?" Then he struck his hand and stumbled and almost broke it. Abu Hurayrah said to his two collarbones and to his mouth, "Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers" [Quran 15:95].
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنِ الْعَجْلَانِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَتَبَخْتَرُ فِي بُرْدَيْنِ خَسَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَهُوَ يَتَجَلْجَلُ فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ فَتًى قَدْ سَمَّاهُ وَهُوَ فِي حُلَّةٍ لَهُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَهَكَذَا كَانَ يَمْشِي ذَلِكَ الْفَتَى الَّذِي خُسِفَ بِهِ؟ ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ فَعَثَرَ عَثْرَةً كَادَ يَتَكَسَّرُ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ لِلْمَنْخَرَيْنِ وَلِلْفَمِ {إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ} [الحجر 95]

chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd > Hārūn > Ibn al-Mughīrah > ʿAmr b. Abū Qays > al-Zubayr b. ʿAdī > Khirāsh b. Jubayr
body_en: [Machine] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbidding stone-throwing. A young man neglected this and thought that the elderly Shaykh was not paying attention to him, so he threw a stone. The Shaykh then said to him, 'Did I not tell you that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbidding stone-throwing, and yet you still do it? By Allah, I will not witness your funeral, nor will I visit you when you are sick, and I will never speak to you again.' So I said to my companion who was known as Muhajir, 'Go to Khirash and ask him about it.' He went to him and asked him, and he narrated the incident to him."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي قَيْسٍ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ خِرَاشِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَتًى يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ شَيْخٌ لَا تَخْذِفْ «فَإِنِّي
body: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ» فَغَفَلَ الْفَتَى وَظَنَّ أَنَّ الشَّيْخَ لَا يَفْطِنُ لَهُ فَخَذَفَ فَقَالَ لَهُ الشَّيْخُ أُحَدِّثُكَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ثُمَّ تَخْذِفُ؟ وَاللَّهِ لَا أَشْهَدُ لَكَ جَنَازَةً وَلَا أَعُودُكَ فِي مَرَضٍ وَلَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا فَقُلْتُ لِصَاحِبٍ لِي يُقَالُ لَهُ مُهَاجِرٌ انْطَلِقْ إِلَى خِرَاشٍ فَاسْأَلْهُ فَأَتَاهُ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْهُ فَحَدَّثَهُ

chain_en: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb > Ḥammād b. Zayd > Ayyūb > Saʿīd b. Jubayr > ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade throwing stones and said, "It does not catch prey, nor does it injure an enemy. Rather, it breaks teeth and gouges eyes." So a man raised something between him and Sa'id, close to the ground, and asked, "Is this it? What is this?" Sa'id replied, "Shouldn't you see that I am telling you about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , then you belittle it and I will never speak to you again."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ قَالَ
body: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْخَذْفِ وَقَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَا تَصْطَادُ صَيْدًا وَلَا تَنْكَأُ عَدُوًّا وَلَكِنَّهَا تَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَتَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ» فَرَفَعَ رَجُلٌ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ سَعِيدٍ قَرَابَةٌ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَالَ هَذِهِ؟ وَمَا تَكُونُ هَذِهِ؟ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَلَا أُرَانِي أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ تَهَاوَنُ بِهِ لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا

chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd > Kahmas b. al-Ḥasan > ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah > Raʾá ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal a man from Aṣḥābih Yakhdhif
body_en: [Machine] Abdullah ibn Mughaffal saw a man from his companions throwing stones, so he said to him: "Do not throw stones, for indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it or dislike it. And he said, 'It does not cause harm to the enemy nor does it bring food as prey, but it can cause damage to the eye and break the tooth.'" Then he saw him afterwards still throwing stones, so he said to him: "Did I not inform you that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it, and here I see you still throwing stones? By Allah, I will never speak to you again."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ؛ حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ؛ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ قَالَ
body: رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُغَفَّلٍ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَا تَخْذِفْ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ أَوْ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ الْخَذْفَ وَقَالَ «إنَّهُ لَا يُنْكَأُ بِهِ عَدُوٌّ وَلَا يُصَادُ بِهِ صَيْدٌ وَلَكِنَّهُ قَدْ يَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ وَيَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ» ثُمَّ رَآهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَلَمْ أُخْبِرْكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كانَ يَنْهَى عنْهُ ثُمَّ أَرَاكَ تَخْذِفُ وَاللَّهِ لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا

chain_en: Marwān b. Muḥammad > Saʿīd b. Bashīr > Qatādah > Ḥaddath Ibn Sīrīn a man Biḥadīth
body_en: [Machine] About the Prophet ﷺ , a man said: "So-and-so said this and that." Ibn Sirin said, "Let me tell you about the Prophet ﷺ . When I say something, I say it on his authority. I do not mention anyone else's words. I will never speak to you again."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ رَجُلًا بِحَدِيثٍ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ قَالَ فُلَانٌ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَتَقُولُ قَالَ فُلَانٌ وَفُلَانٌ كَذَا وَكَذَا لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا

body_en: When women ask permission for going to the mosque, do not prevent them. (Using translation from Muslim 442a)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْ أَحَدَكُمُ امْرَأَتُهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَا يَمْنَعْهَا» فَقَالَ فُلَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِذًا وَاللَّهِ أَمْنَعُهَا فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَشَتَمَهُ شتمةً لَمْ أَرَهُ شْتمها أَحَدًا قَبْلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَقُولُ إِذًا وَاللَّهِ أَمْنَعُهَا

chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd > Hārūn b. al-Mughīrah > Maʿrūf > Abū al-Mukhāriq > Dhakar ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
body_en: [Machine] "The Prophet ﷺ forbade the exchange of two dirhams for one dirham. So-and-so said, 'I do not see anything wrong with this, exchanging one by one.' 'Ubadah said, 'I say what the Prophet ﷺ said, and I do not see any harm in it. By Allah, it will never darken me, nor you, saqf (roof).'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُخَارِقِ قَالَ ذَكَرَ عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنْ دِرْهَمَيْنِ بِدِرْهَمٍ» فَقَالَ فُلَانٌ مَا أَرَى بِهَذَا بَأْسًا يَدًا بِيَدٍ فَقَالَ عُبَادَةُ أَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَتَقُولُ لَا أَرَى بِهِ بَأْسًا وَاللَّهِ لَا يُظِلُّنِي وَإِيَّاكَ سَقْفٌ أَبَدًا

chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Rifāʿī > Abū ʿĀmir al-ʿAqadī > Zamʿah > Salamah b. And Hrām > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Do not approach women at night." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ faced a caravan and two men hurried to their families and both found other men with their wives.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ عَنْ زَمْعَةَ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ وَهْرَامٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَطْرُقُوا النِّسَاءَ لَيْلًا» قَالَ وَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَافِلًا فانْسلَ رَجُلَانِ إِلَى أَهْلَيْهِمَا فَكِلَاهُمَا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا

chain_en: Abū al-Mughīrah > al-Awzāʿī > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ḥarmalah al-Aslamī > Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
body_en: [Machine] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned from a journey, he would stop at the mosque and then say, 'Do not engage with women at night.' Two men who had heard his statement then went to their respective homes and found each of their wives with another man."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ نَزَلَ الْمُعَرَّسَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «لَا تَطْرُقُوا النِّسَاءَ لَيْلًا» فَخَرَجَ رَجُلَانِ مِمَّنْ سَمِعَ مَقَالَتَهُ فَطَرَقَا أهْلْهما فَوَجَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا

chain_en: Abū al-Mughīrah > al-Awzāʿī > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ḥarmalah > Jāʾ a man > Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib Yuwaddiʿuh Biḥaj or ʿUmrah
body_en: [Machine] "He does not leave (the mosque) until he prays, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'No one should leave the mosque after the call to prayer except a hypocrite, except for a man who has a valid excuse and intends to come back to the mosque.' He said, 'My companions in Al-Harra said: 'So he (the man with a valid excuse) left (the mosque).' He said, 'He (the man with a valid excuse) continued to keep the remembrance of Allah in his heart until it was reported that he fell from his mount and his thigh was broken.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حَرْمَلَةَ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ يُوَدِّعُهُ بِحَجٍّ أَوْ عُمْرَةٍ فَقَالَ
body: لَهُ لَا تَبْرَحْ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَخْرُجُ بَعْدَ النِّدَاءِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ إِلَّا مُنَافِقٌ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ أَخْرَجَتْهُ حاجةُ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ الرَّجْعَةَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ» فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَصْحَابِي بِالْحَرَّةِ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ قَالَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ سَعِيدٌ يَوْلَعُ بِذِكْرِهِ حَتَّى أُخْبِرَ أَنَّهُ وَقَعَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَانْكَسَرَتْ فَخِذُهُ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Who doesn't want to bore people?
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُمِلَّ النَّاسَ

body: «لَا تُمِلُّوا النَّاسَ»

chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ يَقُولُ

chain_en: al-Walīd b. Hishām > al-Ḥārith b. Yazīd al-Ḥimṣī > ʿAmr b. Qays
body_en: [Machine] I traveled with my father to Yazid ibn Muawiya in Hawarin after the death of Muawiya to offer our condolences and congratulate him on the caliphate. There was a man in its mosque saying, "Indeed, it is one of the signs of the Hour that the wicked will be elevated, and the good will be lowered. Indeed, it is one of the signs of the Hour that speech will be widespread, and actions will be concealed. Indeed, it is one of the signs of the Hour that the [mathnā] will be recited, and no one will be found has changed it." He was asked, "What is the mathnā?" He replied, "It is what is written from books other than the Quran. So, adhere to the Quran, for with it you are guided, rewarded, and questioned." I did not know who the man was, and I narrated this incident later in Homs. A man from the people said to me, "Do you not know him?" I said, "No." He said, "That was Abdullah ibn Amr (may Allah be pleased with him)."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِمْصِيُّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ

chain_en: Sahl b. Ḥammād > Shuʿbah > al-Ashʿath
body_en: [Machine] About his father, Abdullah said, "I saw a man with a paper in which it was written: Subhan Allah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illa Allah, Allahu Akbar. I asked him to give it to me, but he refused. Then, he promised to give it to me later. So, I came to Abdullah and found it with him. He said, 'What is in this book is innovation, temptation, and misguidance. Indeed, those who came before you were destroyed because of things like this. They wrote it and their tongues enjoyed it, and their hearts were filled with it. Therefore, I am determined that whoever knows the whereabouts of this book, except if he indicates it, I will take an oath by Allah.' Shu'bah asked, 'Did he take an oath by Allah?' He said, 'I think he did, for if it were mentioned to him at the monastery of Hind, we would see him coming even if it was far away in Kufa, even on foot.'"

body: يَا بَنِيَّ وَبَنِي أَخِي إِنَّكُمْ صِغَارُ قَوْمٍ يُوشِكُ أَنْ تَكُونُوا كِبَارَ آخَرِينَ فَتَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَرْوِيَهُ أَوْ قَالَ يَحْفَظَهُ فَلْيَكْتُبْهُ وَلْيَضَعْهُ فِي بَيْتِهِ

chain_en: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ > Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah > ʿĀṣim > Shaqīq > Jarīr
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever introduces a good practice that is followed, he will receive its reward and a reward equivalent to that of those who follow it, without that detracting from their reward in their slightest. And whoever introduces a bad practice that is followed, he will receive its sin and a burden of sin equivalent to that of those who follow it, without that detracting from their burden in the slightest.' (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 203)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً عُمِلَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ شَيْءٌ وَمَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ وِزْرِ مَنْ يعَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِم شَيْءٌ»

chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى هُدًى كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ مِثْلُ أُجُورِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أُجُورِهِمْ شَيْئًا وَمَنْ دَعَا إِلَى ضَلَالَةٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ مِثْلُ آثَامِ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ آثَامِهِمْ شَيْئًا»

body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a sermon and exhorted the people to give charity. They were slow to respond until anger became apparent on his face. Then, a man from the Ansar came with a bag filled with items, and the people began to follow suit until it was seen on his face that he was delighted. He said, "Whoever starts a good practice will receive its reward and the reward of those who follow it, without reducing anything from their rewards. And whoever initiates an evil practice shall carry its burden and the burden of those who act upon it, without diminishing anything from their burdens."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ صُبَيْحٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ الْعَبْسِيِّ عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
