chain_en: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd > ʿAbd al-Malik
body_en: [Machine] Regarding generosity in a woman, you witness purity. Does her husband approach her before she has cleansed herself?" He replied, "No, until she has cleansed herself."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ
body: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الطُّهْرَ أَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ قَالَ «لَا حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman if she becomes pure before she performs the ritual bath.
h2_title: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chain_en: Abū al-Nuʿmān > Abū ʿAwānah > Layth b. Abū Sulaym
body_en: [Machine] "If hunger overtakes him, she will wash her private parts and then come to him."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ قَالَ
body: «إِنْ أَدْرَكَهُ الشَّبَقُ غَسَلَتْ فَرْجَهَا ثُمَّ أَتَاهَا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman if she becomes pure before she performs the ritual bath.
h2_title: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chain_en: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ > Sharīk And Saʾalah a man > al-Marʾah Yanqaṭiʿ > Hā al-Dam Ayaʾtīhā Zawjuhā Qabl > Taghtasil > Qāl ʿAbd al-Malik > ʿAṭāʾ
body_en: [Machine] "To be from the hadith of Layth, which I do not know from the hadith of Abdul Malik," said Abu Muhammad Al-Shabiq, who desires it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ شَرِيكًا وَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ الْمَرْأَةُ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ أَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟ فَقَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ أَنَّهُ «رَخَّصَ فِي ذَلِكَ لِلشَّبِقِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «أَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَخْطَأَ وأَخَافُ
body: أَنْ يَكُونَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ لَيْثٍ لَا أَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الشَّبِقُ الَّذِي يَشْتَهِي

chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá > Zaʿam Lanā Hushaym > Abū Ḥurrah Wāṣil b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman > al-Ḥasan
body_en: [Machine] "I saw women from the women of the city praying in khidab."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى قَالَ زَعَمَ لَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ أَبِي حُرَّةَ وَاصِلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
body: «رَأَيْتُ نِسَاءً مِنْ نِسَاءِ الْمَدِينَةِ يُصَلِّينَ فِي الْخِضَابِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays in impurity

chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Shuʿbah > Ibn Abū Najīḥ ʿAmman > ʿĀʾishah Suʾilat > al-Marʾah Tamsaḥ > al-Khiḍāb
body_en: [Machine] "I would rather have my hand cut off with knives than that."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ سُئِلَتْ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخِضَابِ فَقَالَتْ
body: «لَأَنْ تُقْطَعَ يَدِي بِالسَّكَاكِينِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays in impurity
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Ibn ʿAwn > Abū Saʿīd
body_en: [Machine] "That a woman asked Aisha: Does the woman pray in her Khidab? She said, 'She should shorten it and widen it.' Abu Muhammad said, 'Abu Sa'id, he is the son of Abu Al-Anbas, and the name of Abu Al-Anbas is Sa'eed bin Kathir bin 'Ubayd.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ
body: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ تُصَلِّي الْمَرْأَةُ فِي الْخِضَابِ قَالَتْ «اسْلُتِيهِ وَرَغْمًا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «أَبُو سَعِيدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي الْعَنَبْسِ وَاسْمُ أَبِي الْعَنَبْسِ سَعِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays in impurity
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chain_en: ʿAffān > Abū ʿAwānah > Qatādah > Abū Mijlaz > Ibn ʿAbbās > Kun Nisāʾunā Yakhtaḍib. Bi-al-Layl Faʾidhā Aṣbaḥn Fataḥnah
body_en: [Machine] "Our women should wear cosmetics at night, and when they wake up, they should remove it, perform ablution, and pray. After the prayer, they should wear cosmetics again. If it is the time of Dhuhr prayer, they should remove it, perform ablution, and pray with perfect adornments. It should not prevent them from praying."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: «كُنَّ نِسَاؤُنَا يَخْتَضِبْنَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَإِذَا أَصْبَحْنَ فَتَحْنَهُ فَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ ثُمَّ يَخْتَضِبْنَ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَتَحْنَهُ فَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ بِأَحْسَنِ خِضَابٍ وَلَا يَمْنَعُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays in impurity
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chain_en: Ḥajjāj > Ḥammād > Ayyūb > Nāfiʿ
body_en: [Machine] That the wives of Ibn Umar used to wear their clothes tight and it was during their menstruation.
chain: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ
body: أَنَّ نِسَاءَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «كُنَّ يَخْتَضِبْنَ وَهُنَّ حُيَّضٌ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays in impurity
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chain_en: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm > Hishām > Qatādah > Abū Mijlaz > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] "Our women should wear their veils when they pray the last evening prayer. And when they wake up in the morning, they should remove it, perform ablution, pray. And when they pray the noon prayer, they should wear it, and when they intend to pray the afternoon prayer, they should remove it and make themselves beautiful and not neglect prayer."
chain: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: «كُنَّ نِسَاؤُنَا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَ الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ اخْتَضَبْنَ فَإِذَا أَصْبَحْنَ أَطْلَقْنَهُ وَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ وَإِذَا صَلَّيْنَ الظُّهْرَ اخْتَضَبْنَ فَإِذَا أَرَدْنَ أَنْ يُصَلِّينَ الْعَصْرَ أَطْلَقْنَهُ فَأَحْسَنَّ خِضَابَهُ وَلَا يَحْبِسنَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá > Hushaym > Mughīrah > Ibrāhīm Wʾkhbrnā Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid > ʿĀmir Fīman Atá Ahlah And Hī Ḥāʾiḍ
body_en: [Machine] From Aamer regarding someone who had relations with his wife while she was menstruating, they said, "It is a sin that has come upon him. He should seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him, and he should not repeat the act."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَنبَأَنَا مُغِيرَةُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وأخْبرنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ
body: عَنْ عَامِرٍ فِيمَنْ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَا «ذَنْبٌ أَتَاهُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَيَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ وَلَا يَعُودُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating
h2_title: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Who said: He must perform the expiation
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah > ʿAlī b. Mushir > ʿAbd al-Malik > ʿAṭāʾ
body_en: [Machine] "When a man has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he should give half a dinar in charity." A man from the community said to him, "But Hasan (a narrator) said that one should just free a slave as atonement." He replied, "There is no restriction upon you in drawing closer to Allah to the best of your ability."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ
body: «إِذَا وَقَعَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ» فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَإِنَّ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ يُعْتِقُ رَقَبَةً قَالَ «مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَقَرَّبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ»

body_en: [Machine] The Ansar were not paying their dowries, while the Muhajirun were. A man from the Muhajirun married a woman from the Ansar, and he paid her dowry. However, the Ansari woman refused to accept it. She went to Umm Salamah and mentioned it to her. When the Prophet ﷺ  arrived, the Ansari woman felt embarrassed and left. Umm Salamah then informed the Prophet about what had happened, and he said, "Call her to me." She was summoned and the Prophet said to her, "Your wives are like a cultivable land for you, so come to your land however you wish." [Quran 2:223] "Through one gate." And the gate signifies the only way.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سَابِطٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قُلْتُ لَهَا إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكِ عَنْ شَيْءٍ وَأَنَا أَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَكِ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَتْ سَلْ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي عَمَّا بَدَا لَكَ قَالَ أَسْأَلُكِ عَنْ إِتْيَانِ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ فَقَالَتْ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ

chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ > al-Layth > Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh > Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm > Abū Salamah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: Do you think that is there was a river by the door of any one of you, and he bathed in it five times each day, would there be any trace of dirt left on him? They said: "No trace of dirt would be left on him." He said: "That is the likeness of the five daily prayers. By means of them Allah erases sins." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 462)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «أَرَأَيْتُمْ لَوْ أَنَّ نَهَرًا بِبَابِ أَحَدِكُمْ يَغْتَسِلُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ مَاذَا تَقُولُونَ ذَلِكَ مُبْقِيًا مِنْ دَرَنِهِ؟» قَالُوا لَا يُبْقِي مِنْ دَرَنِهِ قَالَ «كَذَلِكَ مَثَلُ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِهِنَّ الْخَطَايَا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the prayer times
chain_en: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim > Shuʿbah > Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm > Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī Riḍwān Allāh ʿAlayhimā
body_en: [Machine] Jabir, the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Dhuhr when the sun starts declining, 'Asr when it is still a yellow or white glow, Maghrib when the sun sets, 'Isha sometimes early and sometimes delayed depending on the gathering of people. If they gathered early, he would pray early, and if they gathered late, he would pray late. As for Fajr, sometimes he would delay it or pray it with slight brightness.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا قَالَ سَأَلْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي زَمَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ وَكَانَ يُؤَخِّرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ فَقَالَ
body: جَابِرٌ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ وَالْعَصْرَ وَهِيَ حَيَّةٌ أَوْ نَقِيَّةٌ وَالْمَغْرِبَ حِينَ تَجِبُ الشَّمْسُ وَالْعِشَاءَ رُبَّمَا عَجَّلَ وَرُبَّمَا أَخَّرَ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَجَّلَ وَإِذَا تَأَخَّرُوا أَخَّرَ وَالصُّبْحَ رُبَّمَا كَانُوا أَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّيهَا بِغَلَسٍ

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the prayer times
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd al-Ḥanafī > Mālik > Ibn Shihāb > ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz Akhhar al-Ṣalāh Yawm Fadakhal ʿAlayh ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr Faʾakhbarah > al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah Akhhar al-Ṣalāh Yawm Fadakhal ʿAlayh Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī > Mā Hadhā Yā Mughīrah Alays Qad ʿAlimt
body_en: [Machine] "What is this, O Mugheera? Did you not know that Jibreel descended upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed?" Then he said, "I know what you are talking about, O Urwah. Did Jibreel establish the prayer time for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He said, "That was how Bashir ibn Abi Mas'ood narrated it from his father." Urwah added, "Aisha told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to pray Asr and the sun sets in her chambers before it appeared."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ يَوْمًا فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ يَوْمًا فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ
body: مَا هَذَا يَا مُغِيرَةُ؟ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ نَزَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَصَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «بِهَذَا أُمِرْتَ» قَالَ أعْلمْ مَا تُحَدِّثُ يَا عُرْوَةُ أَوَ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ أَقَامَ وَقْتَ الصَّلَاةِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَ كَذَلِكَ كَانَ بَشِيرُ بْنُ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ وَلَقَدْ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ فِي حُجْرَتِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَظْهَرَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] At the beginning of the call to prayer
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd > Salamah > Muḥammad b. Isḥāq
body_en: when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered a bell to be made so that it might be struck to gather the people for prayer, a man carrying a bell in his hand appeared to me while I was asleep, and I said; servant of ‘abd Allah, will you sell the bell? He asked; what will you do with it? I replied; we shall use it to call the people to prayer. He said; should I not suggest you something better than that. I replied: certainly. Then he told me to say: Allah is most great, Allah is most great, Allah is most great, Allah is most great. I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to pray, come to pray; come to salvation; come to salvation. Allah is most great, Allah is most great. I testify that there is no god but Allah. He then moved backward a few steps and said: when you utter the IQAMAH, you should say: Allah is most great, Allah is most great. I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to prayer, come to salvation. The time for prayer has come, the time for prayer has come: Allah is most great, Allah is most great. There is no god but Allah. When the morning came, I came to the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) and informed him of what I had seen in the dream. He said: it is a genuine vision, and he then should use it to call people to prayer, for he has a louder voice than you have. So I got up along with Bilal and began to teach it to him and he used it in making the call to prayer. ‘Umar b. al-khattab (Allah be pleased with him) heard it while he was in his house and came out trailing his cloak and said: Messenger of Allah. By him who has sent you with the truth, I have also seen the kind of thing as has been shown to him. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) said: To Allah be the praise. Abu Dawud said; Al-Zuhri narrated this tradition in a similar way from Sa’id b. al-Musayyib on the authority of ‘Abd Allah b. Zaid. In this version Ibn Ishaq narrated from al-Zuhri: Allah is most great. Allah is most great, Allah is most great, Allah is most great. Ma;mar and yunus narrated from al-Zuhri; Allah is most great, Allah is most great. They did not report it twice again. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 499)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ
body: وَقَدْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حِينَ قَدِمَهَا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي الْمَدِينَةَ إِنَّمَا يُجْتَمَعُ إِلَيْهِ بِالصَّلَاةِ لِحِينِ مَوَاقِيتِهَا بِغَيْرِ دَعْوَةٍ فَهَمَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ بُوقًا كَبُوقِ الْيَهُودِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ بِهِ لِصَلَاتِهِمْ ثُمَّ كَرِهَهُ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِالنَّاقُوسِ فَنُحِتَ لِيُضْرَبَ بِهِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِذْ رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ أَخُو اَلْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ طَافَ بِيَ اللَّيْلَةَ طَائِفٌ مَرَّ بِي رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبَانِ أَخْضَرَانِ يَحْمِلُ نَاقُوسًا فِي يَدِهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ أَتَبِيعُ هَذَا النَّاقُوسَ؟ فَقَالَ وَمَا تَصْنَعُ بِهِ؟ قُلْتُ نَدْعُو بِهِ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ أَفَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى خَيْرٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ؟ قُلْتُ وَمَا هُوَ؟ قَالَ تَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْخَرَ غَيْرَ كَثِيرٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ وَجَعَلَهَا وِتْرًا إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَلَمَّا أخُبِّرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَرُؤْيَا حَقٌّ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَقُمْ مَعَ بِلَالٍ فَأَلْقِهَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّهُ أَنْدَى صَوْتًا مِنْكَ» فَلَمَّا أَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ سَمِعَهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ مِثْلَ مَا رَأَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ فَذَاكَ أَثْبَتُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] At the time of the Fajr call to prayer
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Ibn ʿUyaynah > al-Zuhrī > Sālim > Abīh Yarfaʿuh
body_en: Bilal calls the Adhan during the night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls (the Adhan) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 637)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ
body: «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُؤَذِّنَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] At the time of the Fajr call to prayer
chain_en: Isḥāq > ʿAbdah > ʿUbaydullāh > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar > al-Qāsim > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: [Machine] The Prophet ﷺ  had two muadhins, Bilal and Ibn Umm Maktum. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If Bilal gives the adhan at night, then continue eating and drinking until you hear the adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum." Al-Qasim said, "There was nothing between them except this one would descend while the other ascends."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ أَنْبَأَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَعَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ مُؤَذِّنَانِ بِلَالٌ وَابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى تَسْمَعُوا أَذَانَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ» فَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ وَمَا كَانَ بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَنْزِلَ هَذَا وَيَرْقَى هَذَا

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Recitation in the Dawn Call to Prayer
chain_en: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar b. Fāris > Yūnus > al-Zuhrī > Ḥafṣ b. ʿUmar b. Saʿd al-Muʾadhhin
body_en: [Machine] Saad used to give the call to prayer (adhan) in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Hafs narrated to me that my family told me that Bilal came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to give him the call to prayer for Fajr prayer, but they said that he was sleeping. So Bilal called out in a loud voice, "Prayer is better than sleep", and it was included in the adhan for Fajr prayer. Abu Muhammad said that Saad was called Al-Qaradh.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ فَارِسٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْمُؤَذِّنِ
body: أَنَّ سَعْدًا كَانَ يُؤَذِّنُ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ حَفْصٌ حَدَّثَنِي أَهْلِي أَنَّ بِلَالًا أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُؤْذِنُهُ لِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالُوا إِنَّهُ نَائِمٌ فَنَادَى بِلَالٌ بِأَعْلَى صَوْتِهِ «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فَأُقِرَّتْ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ يُقَالُ سَعْدٌ الْقَرَظُ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Adhan is repeated twice, and the Iqama is done once.
h2_title: بَابُ الْأَذَانِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، وَالْإِقَامَةِ مَرَّةً
chain_en: Sahl b. Ḥammād > Shuʿbah > Abū Jaʿfar > Muslim Abū al-Muthanná > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: I asked Ibn 'Umar about the Adhan and he said: 'At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the phrases of the Adhan were recited twice and the phrases of Iqamah once, except that you should say (the phrase) Qad qamat is-salah (prayer is about to begin)twice. When we heard 'prayer is about to begin' we would perform Wudu' and go out to pray.' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 668)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ أَبِي الْمُثَنَّى عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ الْأَذَانُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى وَالْإِقَامَةُ مَرَّةً غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَالَ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ قَالَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ فَإِذَا سَمِعْنَا الْإِقَامَةَ تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُنَا وَخَرَجَ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Adhan is repeated twice, and the Iqama is done once.
h2_title: بَابُ الْأَذَانِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، وَالْإِقَامَةِ مَرَّةً
chain_en: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī And ʿAffān > Shuʿbah > Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ > Abū Qilābah > Anas > Umir Bilāl
body_en: Bilal was commanded to say the phrases of the Adhan twice and the phrases of the Iqamah once. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 730)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ وَعَفَّانُ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ
body: «أُمِرَ بِلَالٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ الْأَذَانَ وَيُوتِرَ الْإِقَامَةَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Adhan is repeated twice, and the Iqama is done once.
h2_title: بَابُ الْأَذَانِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، وَالْإِقَامَةِ مَرَّةً
chain_en: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb > Ḥammād b. Zayd > Simāk b. ʿAṭiyyah > Ayyūb > Abū Qilābah > Anas > Umir Bilāl
body_en: Anas reported; Bilal was commanded to pronounce Adhan in double pairs and IQAMAH in single pairs. Hammam added in his version; “except IQAMAH”. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 508)
chain: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ
body: «أُمِرَ بِلَالٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ الْأَذَانَ وَيُوتِرَ الْإِقَامَةَ إِلَّا الْإِقَامَةَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The return in the Adhan
chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Hammām > ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal > Makḥūl > Ibn Muḥayrīz > Abū Maḥdhūrah
body_en: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Lowering your voice while saying them (these words). Then you must raise your voice in making the testimony: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify there is no god but Allah; I testify Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I testify Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to salvation, come to salvation. If it is the morning prayer, you must pronounce; prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep, Allah is most great; there is no god but Allah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 500)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَ نَحْوًا مِنْ عِشْرِينَ رَجُلًا فَأَذَّنُوا فَأَعْجَبَهُ صَوْتُ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ فَعَلَّمَهُ الْأَذَانَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَالْإِقَامَةَ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى

h2_title_en: [Machine] The return in the Adhan
chain_en: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī And Ḥajjāj b. al-Minhāl > Hammām > ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal
body_en: the Prophet taught him the Adhan with nineteen phrases, and the Iqamah with seventeen phrases. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 192)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرٌ الْأَحْوَلُ قَالَ حَجَّاجٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَامِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَكْحُولٌ أَنَّ ابْنَ مُحَيْرِيزٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ حَدَّثَهُ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَّمَهُ الْأَذَانَ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ كَلِمَةً وَالْإِقَامَةَ سَبْعَ عَشْرَةَ كَلِمَةً»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The rotation in the Adhan
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Sufyān > ʿAwn b. Abū Juḥayfah from his father > Raʾá Bilāl Adhhan
body_en: [Machine] "Thus, I made it a habit to follow his mouth movements here and there with the adhan."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ رَأَى بِلَالًا أَذَّنَ قَالَ
body: «فَجَعَلْتُ أَتْبَعُ فَاهُ هَاهُنَا وَهَاهُنَا بِالْأَذَانِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The rotation in the Adhan
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad > ʿAbbād > Ḥajjāj > ʿAwn b. Abū Juḥayfah from his father
body_en: [Machine] That Bilal saw a gazelle and then he called for prayer and placed his fingers in his ears, and I saw him turn his fingers in his ears. Abdullah said: This is the Hadith of Thawri and it is the most authentic.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
body: أَنَّ بِلَالًا «رَكَزَ الْعَنَزَةَ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ وَوَضَعَ أُصْبُعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَدُورُ فِي أَذَانِهِ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَدِيثُ الثَّوْرِيِّ أَصَحُّ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The supplication at the call to prayer.
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá > Saʿīd b. Abū Maryam > Mūsá > Ibn Yaʿqūb al-Zamʿī > Abū Ḥāzim b. Dīnār > Sahl b. Saʿd
body_en: [Machine] The Prophet of Allah ﷺ  said: There are two things that are not rejected or hardly rejected: supplication during the call to prayer and supplication during a battle when soldiers are engaged in fighting each other.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى هُوَ ابْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الزَّمْعِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ ثِنْتَانِ لَا تُرَدَّانِ أَوْ قَلَّ مَا تُرَدَّانِ الدُّعَاءُ عِنْدَ النِّدَاءِ وَعِنْدَ الْبَأْسِ حِينَ يُلْحِمُ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is said at the call to prayer
chain_en: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar Anabʾnā Yūnus > al-Zuhrī > ʿAṭāʾ b. Yazīd > Abū Saʿīd
body_en: When you hear the Adhan, you should repeat the same words as the mu’adhdhin pronounces. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 522)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنَبأنا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا سَمِعْتُمُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ فَقُولُوا مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is said at the call to prayer
chain_en: Yazīd b. Hārūn Anabʾnā Hishām al-Dastawāʾī > Yaḥyá > Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥārith > ʿĪsá b. Ṭalḥah > Dakhalnā > Muʿāwiyah Fanādá al-Munādī > Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar > Muʿāwiyah Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar > Ashhad > Lā Ilah Illā Allāh > Ashhad > Lā Ilah Illā Allāh > Ashhad
body_en: [Machine] "Indeed, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. He said, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Yahya informed me that some of our companions told him that when he said 'Come to prayer,' he said, 'There is no power or strength except with Allah.' Then Muawiya said, 'Thus I heard your Prophet say."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنَبأنا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ فَنَادَى الْمُنَادِي فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ
body: أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَأَخْبَرَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا أَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَالَ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ هكذا سَمِعْتُ نَبِيَّكُمْ يَقُولُ

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is said at the call to prayer
chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Muḥammad b. ʿAmr from his father from his grandfather > Muʿāwiyah > al-Muʾadhhin > Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar > Muʿāwiyah Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar > al-Muʾadhhin Ashhad > Lā Ilah Illā Allāh Ashhad > Lā Ilah Illā Allāh > Muʿāwiyah Ashhad > Lā Ilah Illā Allāh Thum Ashhad > Lā Ilah Illā Allāh > al-Muʾadhhin Ashhad
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me the Adhan and said: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah (Allah is the Greatest,Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah,I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah)'. Then he repeated it and said: 'Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah; Hayya 'alas-salah, Hayya 'ala-salah; Hayya 'alal-falah Hayya 'alal-falah; Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha ill-Allah (I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to prosperity, come to prosperity; Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there is none worthy of worship except Allah).' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 631)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ سَمِعَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ أَشْهَدُ
body: أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَقَالَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ فَقَالَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The door of the Devil when it hears the call.
h2_title: بُابُ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذَا سَمِعَ النِّدَاءَ فَرَّ
chain_en: And Hb b. Jarīr > Hishām > Yaḥyá > Abū Salamah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] "The Prophet ﷺ said: When the call to prayer is announced, the devil runs away and is in a state of panic, to the point where he is unable to hear the call to prayer. But when the call to prayer is finished, he comes back. And when the iqama (second call to prayer) is announced, he runs away again. But when the iqama is finished, he comes back until he reaches between the person and his heart, and then he says: Remember to do this and that, which he did not remember before. Abu Muhammad said: "Thawb" means it is established."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالصَّلَاةِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لَا يَسْمَعَ الْأَذَانَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ الْأَذَانُ أَقْبَلَ وَإِذَا ثُوِّبَ أَدْبَرَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ التَّثْوِيبُ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى يَخْطِرَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ فَيَقُولُ اذْكُرْ كَذَا وَكَذَا لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ ثُوِّبَ يَعْنِي أُقِيمَ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The dislike of leaving the mosque after the call.
h2_title: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْخُرُوجِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ النِّدَاءِ
chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Shuʿbah > Ibrāhīm b. al-Muhājir > Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ al-Muḥāribī
body_en: A man left the Masjid after the call to prayer had been given, and Abu Hurairah said: 'This man has indeed disobeyed Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ.' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 684)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ
body: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ رَأَى رَجُلًا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ مَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَقَالَ «أَمَّا هَذَا فَقَدْ عَصَى أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] At noon
chain_en: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ Nbʾanā Shuʿayb > al-Zuhrī > Anas b. Mālik
body_en: Anas told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out when the sun had passed its zenith, and led them in Zuhr prayer. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 496)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أنْبأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «خَرَجَ حِينَ زَاغَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ صَلَاةَ الظُّهْرِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Extradition by day
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ > al-Layth > Ibn Shihāb > Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʾAbī Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When the heat becomes intense, cool yourselves down with prayer, for the intensity of the heat is from the breath of Hellfire." Abu Muhammad said, "I have this saying of delaying when they are affected by the heat."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا اشْتَدَّ الْحَرُّ فَأَبْرِدُوا بِالصَّلَاةِ فَإِنَّ شِدَّةَ الْحَرِّ مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ هَذَا عِنْدِي مِن التَّأْخِيرِ إِذَا تَأَذَّوْا بِالْحَرِّ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Translation: "Time of Asr
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá > Ibn Abū Dhiʾb > al-Zuhrī > Anas
body_en: [Machine] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to pray Asr prayer, then the one who goes to Al-Awali comes to him while the sun is still high.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ يَذْهَبُ الذَّاهِبُ إِلَى الْعَوَالِي فَيَأْتِيهَا وَالشَّمْسُ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The time of Maghrib.
chain_en: Isḥāq > Ibn Ibrāhīm al-Ḥanẓalī > Ṣafwān b. ʿĪsá > Yazīd b. Abū ʿUbayd > Salamah b. al-Akwaʿ
body_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to say the Maghrib prayer immediately after the sun had set when its upper side would disappear. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 417)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ هُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ قَالَ
body: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «يُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ سَاعَةَ تَغْرُبُ الشَّمْسُ إِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُهَا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Disliking the delay of Maghrib prayer.
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá > ʿAbbād b. al-ʿAwwām > ʿUmar b. Ibrāhīm > Qatādah > al-Ḥasan > al-Aḥnaf b. Qays > al-ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] From the Prophet (pbuh) said, "My Ummah (nation) will always remain in goodness as long as they do not expect the clash of the stars at Maghrib (sunset)."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ الْأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَزَالُ أُمَّتِي بِخَيْرٍ مَا لَمْ يَنْتَظِرُوا بِالْمَغْرِبِ اشْتِبَاكَ النُّجُومِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Time for dinner
chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād > Abū ʿAwānah > Abū Bishr > Bashīr b. Thābit > Ḥabīb b. Sālim > al-Nuʿmān b. Bashīr
body_en: [Machine] "By Allah, I certainly inform people of the time of this prayer, meaning the Isha prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray it when the moon had set, around the third of the night." Yahya narrated to us from his book, from Bishr ibn Thabit."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ قَالَ
body: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ بِوَقْتِ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ يَعْنِي صَلَاةَ الْعِشَاءِ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّيهَا لِسُقُوطِ الْقَمَرِ لِثَالِثَةٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَمَلَّاهُ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ كِتَابِهِ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is recommended when delaying dinner?
h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chain_en: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl And ʿAmrū b. ʿĀṣim > Ḥammād b. Salamah > ʿĀṣim b. Bahdalah > Abū Ṣāliḥ > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delayed the Isha prayer on one night until almost one-third of the night had passed or close to it. He came (to the mosque) and found the people reclining and dozing off, some even sleeping. He became angry and said, "If a man among you calls the people for prayer and leads them in prayer, it would be better. And if a man among you were to lead the people in prayer and then go to his family and find them sleeping, he should set fire to their houses with fire."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ وَعَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: أَخَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَاةَ الْعِشَاءِ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ حَتَّى كَادَ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ قَرِيبُهُ فَجَاءَ وَفِي النَّاسُ رُقَّودٌ وَهُمْ عِزُونَ وَهُمْ حِلَقٌ فَغَضِبَ فَقَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلًا ناَدَى النَّاسَ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو نَدَبَ النَّاسَ إِلَى عَرْقٍ أَوْ مِرْمَاتَيْنِ لَأَجَابُوا إِلَيْهِ وَهُمْ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنْ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ لَهَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ أَتَخَلَّفَ عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الدُّورِ الَّذِينَ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنْ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ فَأُضْرِمَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ بِالنِّيرَانِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is recommended when delaying dinner?
h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chain_en: Naṣr b. ʿAlī > ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Maʿmar > al-Zuhrī > ʿUrwah > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed 'Isha' until 'Umar called him and said: 'The women and children have gone to sleep.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and said: 'There is no one who is offering this prayer but you.' And at that time no one used to pray except the people of Al-Madinah. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 482)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْعِشَاءِ حَتَّى نَادَاهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ قَدْ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالصِّبْيَانُ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ يُصَلِّي هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ غَيْرَكُمْ» وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ يُصَلِّي يَوْمَئِذٍ غَيْرَ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is recommended when delaying dinner?
h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chain_en: Isḥāq > Muḥammad b. Bakr > Ibn Jurayj > al-Mughīrah b. Ḥakīm > Um Kulthūm b. Abū Bakr > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ secluded himself one night until most of the night had passed and the people of the mosque had gone to sleep. Then he went out and prayed it and said, "It is its time, but I did not want to make it difficult for my Ummah."
chain: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ أَنَّ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ عَامَّةُ اللَّيْلِ وَرَقَدَ أَهْلُ الْمَسْجِدِ فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّاهَا فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ لَوَقْتُهَا لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي»

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is recommended when delaying dinner?
h2_title: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf Nbʾanā Sufyān > ʿAmr > ʿAṭāʾ > Ibn ʿAbbās And Ibn Jurayj > ʿAṭāʾ > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: [Machine] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delayed the prayer one night. It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, the women and children have fallen asleep." He went out while wiping the water off his face and said, "It is time, if it were not for me inconveniencing my nation."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ أنْبأَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الصَّلَاةَ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالْوِلْدَانُ فَخَرَجَ وَهُوَ يَمْسَحُ الْمَاءَ عَنْ شِقِّهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «هُوَ الْوَقْتُ لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Translation: At-Taghlis in the dawn.
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > al-Awzāʿī > al-Zuhrī > ʿUrwah > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: [Machine] The wives of the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Fajr prayer with the Prophet ﷺ and then they would return home covered with their outer garments before being recognized.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: «كُنَّ نِسَاءُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يُصَلِّينَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الْفَجْرَ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعْنَ مُتَلَفِّعَاتٍ بِمُرُوطِهِنَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُعْرَفْنَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Traveling at Dawn
chain_en: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl > Shuʿbah > Muḥammad b. Isḥāq > ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar b. Qatādah > Maḥmūd b. Labīd > Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
body_en: [Machine] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Set out for the Fajr prayer as it is the greatest reward."
chain: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَسْفِرُوا بِصَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ لِلْأَجْرِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Traveling at Dawn
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Sufyān > Ibn ʿAjlān > ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar b. Qatādah > Maḥmūd b. Labīd > Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Illuminate with the Fajr prayer, for it is the greatest in reward."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَوِّرُوا بِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ لِلْأَجْرِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Traveling at Dawn
chain_en: Sufyān
body_en: [Machine] Regarding Ibn Ajlan, about him, or "Asfiroo"
chain: أخْبرنا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ
body: عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ نَحْوَهُ أَوْ «أَسْفِرُوا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Whoever catches a unit of prayer has indeed caught+the rest
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةٍ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Kathīr > al-Awzāʿī > al-Zuhrī > Abū Salamah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever catches up with a rak'ah of Jumu'ah prayer has caught up with it." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1425)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Whoever catches a unit of prayer has indeed caught+the rest
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةٍ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ
chain_en: Ibn ʿUyaynah > al-Zuhrī > Abū Salamah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] "About the Prophet peace be upon him with his likeness."
chain: أخْبرنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِمِثْلِهِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Whoever catches a unit of prayer has indeed caught+the rest
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةٍ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd > Mālik > Zayd b. Aslam > ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār > Busr b. Saʿīd > ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Aʿraj Yuḥaddithūnah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever catches one Rak'ah of the 'Asr before the sun sets, then he has caught it, and whoever catches one Rak'ah of the Subh before the sun rises, then he has caught it." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 699)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَعَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ يُحَدِّثُونَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصُّبْحِ رَكْعَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا وَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْعَصْرِ رَكْعَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The preservation of prayers
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr al-Ḥumaydī > ʿAbdullāh b. Wahb > ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith > Darrāj Abū al-Samḥ > Abū al-Haytham > Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: "If you see a man frequenting the mosques, then bear witness to his faith. Allah says: 'The mosques of Allah shall be maintained only by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day. [At-Taubah: 18]'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 802)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ دَرَّاجٍ أَبِي السَّمْحِ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الرَّجُلَ يَعْتَادُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَاشْهَدُوا لَهُ بِالْإِيمَانِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ {إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ} [التوبة 18]

h2_title_en: [Machine] The preservation of prayers
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Sufyān > Abū Sahl > Wʾnbʾanā Abū Nuʿaym > Sufyān > ʿUthmān b. Ḥakīm > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū ʿAmrah > ʿUthmān
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:Whoever prays ʿIshaʿ in congregation, it will be like spending half the night in prayer (qiyam) and whoever prays ʿIshaʿ and Fajr in congregation, it will be like spending the whole night in prayer.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 491)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ قَالَ وأنْبأَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ كَانَ كَقِيَامِ نِصْفِ لَيْلَةٍ وَمَنْ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ كَانَ كَقِيَامِ لَيْلَةٍ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The recommendation of praying in the early time.
h2_title: بَابُ: اسْتحْبَابِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ
chain_en: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī > Shuʿbah > al-Walīd b. ʿAyzār > Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī
body_en: [Machine] The owner of this house told me and gestured with his hand towards the house of Abdullah that he asked the Prophet ﷺ which actions are better or more beloved to Allah. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Praying at its appointed time."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَيْزَارٍ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ يَقُولُ
body: حَدَّثَنِي صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الدَّارِ وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَيُّ الْأَعَمَالِ أَفْضَلُ أَوْ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ «الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى مِيقَاتِهَا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] The recommendation of praying in the early time.
h2_title: بَابُ: اسْتحْبَابِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ
chain_en: Abū Nuʿaym > ʿAbd al-Raḥman > Ibn al-Nuʿmān al-Anṣārī > Saʿd b. Isḥāq b. Kaʿb b. ʿUjrah al-Anṣārī from his father > Kaʿb
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out to us while we were in the mosque, seven of us. Three of us were Arabs and four of us were non-Arabs, or four of us were Arabs and three of us were non-Arabs. The Prophet ﷺ  came out from one of the corners of the mosque until he sat with us and asked, "What made you sit here?" We replied, "We are waiting for the prayer." He then tapped the ground with his finger and turned it over for a while, then raised his head and asked, "Do you know what your Lord says?" We replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "He says, 'Whoever performs the prayer at its prescribed time and observes its proper limits, it will be a guarantee for him to enter Paradise. And whoever does not perform the prayer at its prescribed time and does not observe its proper limits, he will not have any guarantee from me. If I will, I will admit him to Hell, and if I will, I will admit him to Paradise.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ النُّعْمَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي سَعْدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ
body: خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ سَبْعَةٌ مِنَّا ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنْ عَرَبِنَا وَأَرْبَعَةٌ مِنْ مَوَالِينَا أَوْ أَرْبَعَةٌ مِنْ عَرَبِنَا وَثَلَاثَةٌ مِنْ مَوَالِينَا قَالَ فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ بَعْضِ حُجَرِهِ حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ «مَا يُجْلِسُكُمْ هَاهُنَا؟» قُلْنَا انْتِظَارُ الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ فَنَكَتَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنَكَسَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ رَفَعَ إِلَيْنَا رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ «هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَا يَقُولُ رَبُّكُمْ؟» قَالَ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ مَنْ صَلَّى الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا فَأَقَامَ حَدَّهَا كَانَ لَهُ بِهِ عَلَيَّ عَهْدٌ أُدْخِلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَلَمْ يُقِمْ حَدَّهَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عِنْدِي عَهْدٌ إِنْ شِئْتُ أَدْخَلْتُهُ النَّارَ وَإِنْ شِئْتُ أَدْخَلْتُهُ الْجَنَّةَ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Praying behind someone who delays prayer beyond its appointed time
h2_title: بَابُ الصَّلَاةِ خَلْفَ مِنْ يُؤَخِّرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا
chain_en: Sahl b. Ḥammād > Shuʿbah > Budayl > Abū al-ʿĀliyah al-Barrāʾ > ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit > Abū Dhar
body_en: [Machine] The Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "What would you do if you were among people who delay the prayer from its time?" He said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "Pray the prayer at its appointed time and then leave, for if the prayer is established while you are in the mosque, then pray with them."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ الْبَرَّاءِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُ «كَيْفَ أَنْتَ إِذَا بَقِيتَ فِي قَوْمٍ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا؟» قَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَالَ «صَلِّ الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَاخْرُجْ فَإِنْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَأَنْتَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلِّ مَعَهُمْ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] Praying behind someone who delays prayer beyond its appointed time
h2_title: بَابُ الصَّلَاةِ خَلْفَ مِنْ يُؤَخِّرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا
chain_en: Yazīd b. Hārūn > Hammām > Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī > ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit > Abū Dhar
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Abu Dhar, what would you do if you come across leaders who postpone the prayer from its time?" I asked, "What do you command me, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Pray the prayer in its proper time and make your prayer with them as optional prayers." Abu Muhammad ibn As-Samit, who is the son of the brother of Abu Dhar, said.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ إِذَا أَدْرَكْتَ أُمَرَاءَ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا؟» قُلْتُ مَا تَأْمُرُنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «صَلِّ الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَاجْعَلْ صَلَاتَكَ مَعَهُمْ نَافِلَةً» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنُ الصَّامِتِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَخِي أَبِي ذَرٍّ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Whoever sleeps through a prayer or forgets it.
h2_title: بَابُ مَنْ نَامَ عَنْ صَلَاةٍ أَوْ نَسِيَهَا
chain_en: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir > Saʿīd > Qatādah > Anas
body_en: Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it, for Allah says: and perform the Salah for My remembrance. [1] [1] Ta-Ha 20:14. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 619)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَلْيُصَلِّهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ {وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي} [طه 14]

h2_title_en: [Machine] Missing the Asr prayer
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي الَّذي تَفُوتُهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Ibn ʿUyaynah > al-Zuhrī > Sālim > Abīh Yarfaʿuh
body_en: The Messenger of Allah said: "The one who misses the 'Asr prayer, it is as if he has been cheated out of his family and wealth." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 685)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ
body: إِنَّ الَّذِي تَفُوتُهُ الصَّلَاةُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Missing the Asr prayer
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي الَّذي تَفُوتُهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf > Sufyān > ʿUbaydullāh > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever misses the Asr prayer, it is as if he has lost his family and children." Abu Muhammad said, "Or his wealth."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ فَاتَتْهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ أَوْ مَالَهُ

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the Middle Prayer
chain_en: Yazīd b. Hārūn Nbʾanā Hishām b. Ḥassān > Muḥammad > ʿAbīdah > ʿAlī
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of al-Khandaq: ʿWhat is wrong with them? May Allah fill their houses and graves with fire as they distracted us from the middle prayer until the sun set.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1221)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أنْبأَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ «مَلَأَ اللَّهُ قُبُورَهُمْ وَبُيُوتَهُمْ نَارًا كَمَا حَبَسُونَا عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْوُسْطَى حَتَّى غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the case of abandoning prayer
chain_en: Abū ʿĀṣim > Ibn Jurayj > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir > or > Jābir
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no difference between a servant and associating partners with Allah or disbelief, except abandoning prayer." Abu Muhammad Al-Abd said, "If a person abandons prayer without excuse or reason, it must be said that he is committing disbelief, and he should not be described as a disbeliever."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ أَوْ قَالَ جَابِرٌ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَيْسَ بَيْنَ الْعَبْدِ وَبَيْنَ الشِّرْكِ أَوْ بَيْنَ الْكُفْرِ إِلَّا تَرْكُ الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْعَبْدُ إِذَا تَرَكَهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ وَعِلَّةٍ لَا بُدَّ مِنْ أَنْ يُقَالَ بِهِ كُفْرٌ وَلَمْ يَصِفْ بِالْكُفْرِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the conversion of the qibla from Al-Masjid al-Aqsa to the Kaaba
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي تَحْوِيلِ الْقِبْلَةِ مِنْ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ
chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān > Sulaymān b. Bilāl > ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: [Machine] While people were performing the Fajr prayer in Quba, a man came to them and said, "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has been revealed the Quran and he has been commanded to face the Kaaba in prayer, so face towards it." The people's faces were initially directed towards Sham (Syria) but they turned and faced towards the Kaaba.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: بَيْنَمَا النَّاسُ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ فِي قُبَاءٍ إذ جَاءَهُمْ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ وَأُمِرَ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا وَكَانَ وُجهُ النَّاسِ إِلَى الشَّامِ فَاسْتَدَارُوا فَوَجَّهُوا إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the conversion of the qibla from Al-Masjid al-Aqsa to the Kaaba
h2_title: بَابٌ فِي تَحْوِيلِ الْقِبْلَةِ مِنْ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá > Isrāʾīl > Simāk > ʿIkrimah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: when the Prophet (May peace be upon him) turned towards the Ka’bah (in prayer), the people asked : Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him)! what will happen with those who died while they prayed with their faces towards Jerusalem ? Allah the Exalted, then revealed : “And never would Allah make your faith of no effect.” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4680)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ مَاتُوا وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ إِلَى بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ؟ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ} [البقرة 143]

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the opening of the prayer.
chain_en: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn > Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah > Budayl al-ʿUqaylī > Abū al-Jawzāʾ > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: [Machine] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to commence the prayer with the takbir (saying "Allahu Akbar") and commence the recitation with "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil 'alameen" (Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds) [Al-Fatihah: 2]. And he concludes it with the tasleem (saying "Assalamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah")
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا بُدَيْلٌ الْعُقَيْلِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَوْزَاءِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلَاةَ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ وَيَفْتَتِحُ الْقِرَاءَةَ بِ {الحمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} [الفاتحة 2] وَيَخْتِمُهَا بِالتَّسْلِيمِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Raising the hands at the beginning of prayer
h2_title: بَابُ رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ عِنْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd al-Ḥanafī > Ibn Abū Dhiʾb > Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. ʿAṭāʾ > Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Thawbān > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: [Machine] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to raise his hands (in supplication) whenever he stood up for prayer."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَمْ يَكُنْ يَقُومُ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ إِلَّا رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ مَدًّا»

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is said after the opening of the prayer?
h2_title: بَابُ: مَا يُقَالُ بَعْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ
chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān > ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Salamah from his uncle al-Mājishūn > al-Aʿraj > ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Rāfiʿ > ʿAlī b. Abū Ṭālib Raḍī Allāh Taʿālá ʿAnh
body_en: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ started to pray, he would say Takbir, then say: "Wajahtu wajhi lilladhi fataras-samawatiwal-arda hanifan wa ma ana minal-mushrikin. Inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi rabbil-alamin, la sharika lahu, wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana min al-muslimin. Allahumma! Antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant, ana abduka zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bidhanbi faghfirli dhunubi jami'an, la yaghfirudhunuba illa anta, wahdini lihasanil-ahklaqi, la yahdi li ahsaniha illa anta wasrif anni sayy'aha la yasrifu anni sayy'aha illa anta, labaika wa sa'daika, wal-khairu kulluhu fi yadaika wash-sharru laisa ilaika ana bika wa ilaika ana bika wa ilaika tabarkta wa ta'alaita astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik. (Verily, I have turned my face toward Him who created the Heavens and the Earth hanifa (worhsipping none but Allah Alone), and I am not of the idolaters. Verily, my salah, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the all that exists. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am one of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign and there is none worthy of worship but You. I am Your slave, I have wronged myself and I acknowledge my sin. Forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of manners for none can guide to the best of them but You. Protect me from bad manners for none can protect against them but You. I am at Your service, all goodness is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I rely on You and turn to You, blessed and exalted are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 897)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمِّهِ الْمَاجِشُونَ عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهُ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ كَبَّرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] What is said after the opening of the prayer?
h2_title: بَابُ: مَا يُقَالُ بَعْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ
chain_en: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī > Jaʿfar b. Sulaymān > ʿAlī b. ʿAlī > Abū al-Mutawakkil > Abū Saʿīd
body_en: [Machine] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would get up at night, he would say: 'Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your Majesty. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan, the accursed, from his whispers, breaths, and blowing.' Then he would begin his prayer. Ja'far explained it as follows: 'His whispers refers to death, his breaths refers to poetry, and his blowing refers to arrogance.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَكَبَّرَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَفْتِحُ صَلَاتَهُ قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ وَفَسَّرَهُ مَطَرٌ هَمْزُهُ الْمُوتَةُ وَنَفْثُهُ الشِّعْرُ وَنَفْخُهُ الْكِبْرُ

h2_title_en: [Machine] The Dislike of Uttering "In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" Aloud
h2_title: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْجَهْرِ بِبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
chain_en: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm > Hishām > Qatādah > Anas
body_en: [Machine] "The Prophet, Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman used to begin reciting by saying, 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds' [Al-Fatiha 2]." Abu Muhammad said, 'With this, we say, and I do not see the need to audibly say 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.'"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ كَانُوا يَفْتَتِحُونَ الْقِرَاءَةَ بِ {الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} [الفاتحة 2] قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ بِهَذَا نَقُولُ وَلَا أَرَى الْجَهْرَ بِبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] Holding the right hand over the left in prayer.
h2_title: بَابُ قَبْضِ الْيَمِينِ عَلَى الشِّمِالِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chain_en: Abū Nuʿaym > Zuhayr > Abū Isḥāq > ʿAbd al-Jabbār b. Wāʾil from his father
body_en: [Machine] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  placing his right hand over his left hand, close to the wrist."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى الْيُسْرَى قَرِيبًا مِنَ الرُّسْغِ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] No prayer without reciting Al-Fatiha.
h2_title: بَابٌ: لَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ
chain_en: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar > Yūnus > al-Zuhrī > Maḥmūd b. al-Rabīʿ > ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
body_en: [Machine] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever does not recite from the mother of the book, then his prayer is not valid."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأْ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ فَلَا صَلَاةَ لَهُ»

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the two bags
chain_en: ʿAffān > Ḥammād b. Salamah > Ḥumayd > al-Ḥasan > Samurah b. Jundub
body_en: [Machine] The Prophet ﷺ  used to remain silent when he entered prayer and when he finished reciting. Imran ibn Husayn disapproved of this and they wrote to Ubay ibn Ka'b. He replied to them saying that Samurah was telling the truth. Abu Muhammad says Qatadah used to say three silences, and in the raised narration, there are two silences.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَسْكُتُ سَكْتَتَيْنِ إِذَا دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ فَكَتَبُوا إِلَى أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ قَدْ صَدَقَ سَمُرَةُ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ كَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَقُولُ ثَلَاثُ سَكَتَاتٍ وَفِي الْحَدِيثِ الْمَرْفُوعِ سَكْتَتَانِ

h2_title_en: [Machine] In the two bags
chain_en: Bishr b. Ādam > ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād > ʿUmārah b. al-Qaʿqāʿ > Abū Zurʿah b. ʿAmr > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept silence between the takbir and the recitation of Qur’an. So I asked him, for whom I would give my father and mother as ransom: What do you say during you period of silence between the takbir and the recitation? He replied (that he said): O Allah, purify me from sins as a white garment is purified from filth. O Allah, wash away my sings with snow, water and hail. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 781)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ آدَمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْكُتُ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ إِسْكَاتَةً حَسِبْتُهُ قَالَ هُنَيَّةً فَقُلْتُ لَهُ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِسْكَاتَتَكَ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ أَقُولُ «اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ»

chain_en: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar > Mālik > al-Zuhrī > Sālim from his father
body_en: [Machine] The translation of the provided sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to, when he entered into prayer, say takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar) and raise his hands level with his shoulders, and when he went into ruku' (bowing), he would say takbeer and raise his hands, and when he raised his head from ruku', he would do the same, and he did not raise his hands between the two prostrations or during prostration."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْيَحْصُبِيِّ عَنْ وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ
body: أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَانَ «يُكَبِّرُ إِذَا خَفَضَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ وَيَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ عِنْدَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَيُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ وَضَحُ وَجْهِهِ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ

chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān > Wuhayb b. Khālid > Ayyūb > Abū Qilābah > Mālik b. al-Ḥūwayrith
body_en: [Machine] "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with a group of my people while we were young. We stayed with him for twenty nights, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was a companion to us. chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ قَالَ
body: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ قَوْمِي وَنَحْنُ شَبَبَةٌ فَأَقَمْنَا عِنْدَهُ عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَفِيقًا فَلَمَّا رَأَى شَوْقَنَا إِلَى أَهْلِينَا قَالَ «ارْجِعُوا إِلَى أَهْلِيكُمْ فَكُونُوا فِيهِمْ فَمُرُوهُمْ وَعَلِّمُوهُمْ وَصَلُّوا كَمَا رَأَيْتُمُونِي أُصَلِّي فَإِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ لَكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ ثُمَّ لِيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَكْبَرُكُمْ»

chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ ثَلَاثَةٌ فَلْيَؤُمَّهُمْ أَحَدُهُمْ وَأَحَقُّهُمْ بِالْإِمَامَةِ أَقْرَؤُهُمْ»

chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
